verses.sa:
यां कल्पयन्ति वहतौ वधूमिव विश्वरूपां हस्तकृतां चिकित्सवः ।
सारादेत्वप नुदाम एनाम्॥
verses.tr: yāṃ kalpayanti vahatau vadhūmiva viśvarūpāṃ hastakṛtāṃ cikitsavaḥ sārādetvapa nudāma enām
verses.en: let her depart: away we drive her whom, made with hands, all-beautiful, Skilled men prepare and fashion like a bride amid her nuptial train,

verses.sa:
शीर्षण्वती नस्वती कर्णिनी कृत्याकृता संभृता विश्वरूपा ।
सारादेत्वप नुदाम एनाम्॥
verses.tr: śīrṣaṇvatī nasvatī karṇinī kṛtyākṛtā saṃbhṛtā viśvarūpā sārādetvapa nudāma enām
verses.en: Complete, with head and nose and ears, all-beaute- Oup? wrought with magic skill, Afar let her depart: away we drive her,

verses.sa:
शूद्रकृता राजकृता स्त्रीकृता ब्रह्मभिः कृता।
जाया पत्या नुत्तेव कर्तारं बन्ध्वृच्छतु॥
verses.tr: śūdrakṛtā rājakṛtā strīkṛtā brahmabhiḥ kṛtā jāyā patyā nutteva kartāraṃ bandhvṛcchatu
verses.en: Made by a Sudra or a Prince, by priests or women, let her go. Back to her maker as her kin, like a dame banished by her lord,

verses.sa:
अनयाहमोषध्या सर्वाः कृत्या अदूदुषम्।
यां क्षेत्रे चक्रुर्यां गोषु यां वा ते पुरुषेषु॥
verses.tr: anayāhamoṣadhyā sarvāḥ kṛtyā adūduṣam yāṃ kṣetre cakruryāṃ goṣu yāṃ vā te puruṣeṣu
verses.en: I with this salutary herb have ruined all their magic arts, The spell which they have cast upon thy field, thy cattle, or thy men,

verses.sa:
अघमस्त्वघकृते शपथः शपथीयते।
प्रत्यक् प्रतिप्रहिण्मो यथा कृत्याकृतं हनत्॥
verses.tr: aghamastvaghakṛte śapathaḥ śapathīyate pratyak pratiprahiṇmo yathā kṛtyākṛtaṃ hanat
verses.en: Ill fall on him who doeth ill, on him who curseth fall the curse! We drive her back that she may slay the man who wrought the witchery.

verses.sa:
प्रतीचीन आङ्गिरसोऽध्यक्षो नः पुरोहितः ।
प्रतीचीः कृत्या आकृत्यामून् कृत्याकृतो जहि॥
verses.tr: pratīcīna āṅgiraso'dhyakṣo naḥ purohitaḥ pratīcīḥ kṛtyā ākṛtyāmūn kṛtyākṛto jahi
verses.en: Against her comes the Angirasa, the Priest whose eye is over us. Turn back all witcheries and slay those practisers of magic arts,

verses.sa:
यस्त्वोवाच परेहीति प्रतिकूलमुदाय्यऽम्।
तं कृत्येऽभिनिवर्तस्व मास्मानिच्छो अनागसः॥
verses.tr: yastvovāca parehīti pratikūlamudāyya'm taṃ kṛtye'bhinivartasva māsmāniccho anāgasaḥ
verses.en: Whoever said to thee, Go forth against the foeman up the stream, To him, O Kritya, go thou back, Pursue not us, the sinless ones.

verses.sa:
यस्ते परूंषि संदधौ रथस्येवर्भुर्धिया।
तं गच्छ तत्र तेऽयनमज्ञातस्तेऽयं जनः॥
verses.tr: yaste parūṃṣi saṃdadhau rathasyevarbhurdhiyā taṃ gaccha tatra te'yanamajñātaste'yaṃ janaḥ
verses.en: He who composed thy limbs with thought as a deft joiner builds a car, Go to him: thither lies thy way. This man is all unknown to thee,

verses.sa:
ये त्वा कृत्वालेभिरे विद्वला अभिचारिणः ।
शंभ्वि३दं कृत्यादूषणं प्रतिवर्त्म पुनःसरं तेन त्वा स्नपयामसि॥
verses.tr: ye tvā kṛtvālebhire vidvalā abhicāriṇaḥ śaṃbhvi3daṃ kṛtyādūṣaṇaṃ prativartma punaḥsaraṃ tena tvā snapayāmasi
verses.en: The cunning men, the sorcerers who fashioned thee and held thee fast,—This cures and mars their witchery, this, repellent, drives it back the way it came, With this we make thee swim,

verses.sa:
यद् दुर्भगां प्रस्नपितां मृतवत्सामुपेयिम।
अपैतु सर्वं मत् पापं द्रविणं मोप तिष्ठतु॥
verses.tr: yad durbhagāṃ prasnapitāṃ mṛtavatsāmupeyima apaitu sarvaṃ mat pāpaṃ draviṇaṃ mopa tiṣṭhatu
verses.en: When we have found her ducked and drenched, a hapless cow whose calf hath died, Let all my woe depart and let abundant riches come to me.

verses.sa:
यत् ते पितृभ्यो ददतो यज्ञे वा नाम जगृहुः ।
संदेश्या३त् सर्वस्मात् पापादिमा मुञ्चन्तु त्वौषधीः॥
verses.tr: yat te pitṛbhyo dadato yajñe vā nāma jagṛhuḥ saṃdeśyā3t sarvasmāt pāpādimā muñcantu tvauṣadhīḥ
verses.en: I If, as they gave thy parents aught, they named thee, or at sacrifice, From all their purposed evil let these healing herbs deliver thee,

verses.sa:
देवैनसात् पित्र्यान्नामग्राहात् संदेश्याऽदभिनिष्कृतात्।
मुञ्चन्तु त्वा वीरुधो वीर्येऽण ब्रह्मण ऋग्भिः पयस ऋषीणाम्॥
verses.tr: devainasāt pitryānnāmagrāhāt saṃdeśyā'dabhiniṣkṛtāt muñcantu tvā vīrudho vīrye'ṇa brahmaṇa ṛgbhiḥ payasa ṛṣīṇām
verses.en: From mention of thy name, from sin against the Fathers or the Gods, These herbs of healing shall by prayer release thee, by power, by holy texts, the milk of Rishis.

verses.sa:
यथा वातश्च्यावयति भूम्या रेणुमन्तरिक्षाच्चाभ्रम्।
एवा मत् सर्वं दुर्भूतं ब्रह्मनुत्तमपायति॥
verses.tr: yathā vātaścyāvayati bhūmyā reṇumantarikṣāccābhram evā mat sarvaṃ durbhūtaṃ brahmanuttamapāyati
verses.en: As the wind stirs the dust from earth and drives the rain-cloud from the sky, So, chased and banished by the spell, all misery departs from me.

verses.sa:
अप क्राम नानदती विनद्धा गर्दभीव ।
कर्तृन् नक्षस्वेतो नुत्ता ब्रह्मणा वीर्याऽवता॥
verses.tr: apa krāma nānadatī vinaddhā gardabhīva kartṛn nakṣasveto nuttā brahmaṇā vīryā'vatā
verses.en: Go with a resonant cry; depart, like a she-ass whose cords are loosed. Go to thy makers: hence! away! Go driven by the potent spell,

verses.sa:
अयं पन्थाः कृत्येति त्वा नयामोऽभिप्रहितां प्रति त्वा प्र हिण्मः ।
तेनाभि याहि भञ्जत्यनस्वतीव वाहिनी विश्वरूपा कुरूटिनी॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ panthāḥ kṛtyeti tvā nayāmo'bhiprahitāṃ prati tvā pra hiṇmaḥ tenābhi yāhi bhañjatyanasvatīva vāhinī viśvarūpā kurūṭinī
verses.en: This, Kritya, is thy path, we say, and guide thee. We drive thee back who hast been sent against us. Go by this pathway, breaking loose for onslaught even as a host complete with cars and horses,

verses.sa:
पराक् ते ज्योतिरपथं ते अर्वागन्यत्रास्मदयना कृणुष्व ।
परेणेहि नवतिं नाव्या३ अति दुर्गाः स्रोत्या मा क्षणिष्ठाः परेहि॥
verses.tr: parāk te jyotirapathaṃ te arvāganyatrāsmadayanā kṛṇuṣva pareṇehi navatiṃ nāvyā3 ati durgāḥ srotyā mā kṣaṇiṣṭhāḥ parehi
verses.en: No path leads hitherward for thee to travel, Turn thee from us: far off, thy light is yonder. Fly hence across the ninety floods, the rivers most hard to pass, Begone, and be not wounded,

verses.sa:
वात इव वृक्षान् नि मृणीहि पादय मा गामश्वं पुरुषमुच्छिष एषाम्।
कर्तॄन् निवृत्येतः कृत्योऽप्रजास्त्वाय बोधय॥
verses.tr: vāta iva vṛkṣān ni mṛṇīhi pādaya mā gāmaśvaṃ puruṣamucchiṣa eṣām kartṝn nivṛtyetaḥ kṛtyo'prajāstvāya bodhaya
verses.en: As wind the trees, so smite and overthrow them: leave not cow, horse, or man of them surviving, Return, O Kritya, unto those who made thee. Wake them from sleep to find that they are childless.

verses.sa:
यां ते बर्हिषि यां श्मशाने क्षेत्रे कृत्यां वलगं वा निचख्नुः ।
अग्नौ वा त्वा गार्हपत्येऽभिचेरुः पाकं सन्तं धीरतरा अनागसम्॥
verses.tr: yāṃ te barhiṣi yāṃ śmaśāne kṣetre kṛtyāṃ valagaṃ vā nicakhnuḥ agnau vā tvā gārhapatye'bhiceruḥ pākaṃ santaṃ dhīratarā anāgasam
verses.en: The charm or secret power which they have buried for thee in sacred grass, field, cemetery, Or spell in household fire which men more cunning have wrought against thee innocent and simple,—

verses.sa:
उपाहृतमनुबुद्धं निखातं वैरं त्सार्यन्वविदाम कर्त्रम्।
तदेतु यत आभृतं तत्राश्व इव वि वर्ततां हन्तु कृत्याकृतः प्रजाम्॥
verses.tr: upāhṛtamanubuddhaṃ nikhātaṃ vairaṃ tsāryanvavidāma kartram tadetu yata ābhṛtaṃ tatrāśva iva vi vartatāṃ hantu kṛtyākṛtaḥ prajām
verses.en: That tool of hatred, understood, made ready stealthy and buried deep, have we discovered. Let that go back to whence it came, turn thither like a horse and kill the children of the sorcerer.

verses.sa:
स्वायसा असयः सन्ति नो गृहे विद्मा ते कृत्ये यतिधा परूंषि ।
उत्तिष्ठैव परेहीतोऽज्ञाते किमिहेच्छसि॥
verses.tr: svāyasā asayaḥ santi no gṛhe vidmā te kṛtye yatidhā parūṃṣi uttiṣṭhaiva parehīto'jñāte kimihecchasi
verses.en: Within our house are swords of goodly iron. Kritya, we know thy joints and all their places. Arise this instant and begone! What, stranger! art thou seeking here?

verses.sa:
ग्रीवास्ते कृत्ये पादौ चापि कर्त्स्यामि निर्द्रव ।
इन्द्राग्नी अस्मान् रक्षतां यौ प्रजानां प्रजावती॥
verses.tr: grīvāste kṛtye pādau cāpi kartsyāmi nirdrava indrāgnī asmān rakṣatāṃ yau prajānāṃ prajāvatī
verses.en: O Kritya, I will cut thy throat and hew thy feet off. Run5 begone I Indra and Agni, Guardian Lords of living creatures, shield us well!

verses.sa: सोमो राजाधिपा मृडिता च भूतस्य नः पतयो मृडयन्तु॥
verses.tr: somo rājādhipā mṛḍitā ca bhūtasya naḥ patayo mṛḍayantu
verses.en: May Soma, gracious friend, imperial Sovran, and the world's Masters look on us with favour.

verses.sa:
भवाशर्वावस्यतां पापकृते कृत्याकृते ।
दुष्कृते विद्युतं देवहेतिम्॥
verses.tr: bhavāśarvāvasyatāṃ pāpakṛte kṛtyākṛte duṣkṛte vidyutaṃ devahetim
verses.en: Bhava and Sarva cast the flnsh of lightning, the weapon of the Gods, against the sinner who made the evil thing, who deals in witchcraft!

verses.sa:
यद्येयथ द्विपदी चतुष्पदी कृत्याकृता संभृता विश्वरूपा ।
सेतोष्टापदी भूत्वा पुनः परेहि दुच्छुने॥
verses.tr: yadyeyatha dvipadī catuṣpadī kṛtyākṛtā saṃbhṛtā viśvarūpā setoṣṭāpadī bhūtvā punaḥ parehi ducchune
verses.en: If thou hast come two-footed or four-footed, made by the sorcerer, wrought in perfect beauty, Become eight-footed and go hence. Speed back inj thou evil one.

verses.sa:
अभ्यक्ताक्ता स्वऽरंकृता सर्वं भरन्ती दुरितं परेहि ।
जानीहि कृत्ये कर्तारं दुहितेव पितरं स्वम्॥
verses.tr: abhyaktāktā sva'raṃkṛtā sarvaṃ bharantī duritaṃ parehi jānīhi kṛtye kartāraṃ duhiteva pitaraṃ svam
verses.en: Anointed, balmed, and well adorned, bearing all trouble with thee, go. Even as a daughter knows her sire, so know thy marker, Kritya, thou.

verses.sa:
परेहि कृत्ये मा तिष्ठो विद्धस्येव पदं नय ।
मृगः समृगयुस्त्वं न त्वा निकर्तुमर्हति॥
verses.tr: parehi kṛtye mā tiṣṭho viddhasyeva padaṃ naya mṛgaḥ samṛgayustvaṃ na tvā nikartumarhati
verses.en: Kritya, begone, stay not. Pursue as 'twere the wounded creature's track. He is the chase, the hunter thou: he may not slight or humble thee.

verses.sa:
उत हन्ति पूर्वासिनं प्रत्यादायापर इष्वा ।
उत पूर्वस्य निघ्नतो नि हन्त्यपरः प्रति॥
verses.tr: uta hanti pūrvāsinaṃ pratyādāyāpara iṣvā uta pūrvasya nighnato ni hantyaparaḥ prati
verses.en: He waits, and aiming with his shaft smites him who first would shoot at him, And, when the foeman deals a blow before him, following strikes him down.

verses.sa:
एतद्धि शृणु मे वचोऽथेहि यत एयथ ।
यस्त्वा चकार तं प्रति॥
verses.tr: etaddhi śṛṇu me vaco'thehi yata eyatha yastvā cakāra taṃ prati
verses.en: Hearken to this my word; then go thither away whence thou hast come; to him who made thee go thou back.

verses.sa:
अनागोहत्या वै भीमा कृत्ये मा नो गामश्वं पुरुषं वधीः ।
यत्रयत्रासि निहिता ततस्त्वोत्थापयामसि पर्णाल्लघीयसी भव॥
verses.tr: anāgohatyā vai bhīmā kṛtye mā no gāmaśvaṃ puruṣaṃ vadhīḥ yatrayatrāsi nihitā tatastvotthāpayāmasi parṇāllaghīyasī bhava
verses.en: The slaughter of an innocent, O Kritya, is an awful deed. Slay not cow, horse, or man of ours. In whatsoever place thou art concealed we rouse thee up therefrom: become thou lighter than a leaf.

verses.sa:
यदि स्थ तमसावृता जालेनाभिहिता इव ।
सर्वाः संलुप्येतः कृत्याः पुनः कर्त्रे प्र हिण्मसि॥
verses.tr: yadi stha tamasāvṛtā jālenābhihitā iva sarvāḥ saṃlupyetaḥ kṛtyāḥ punaḥ kartre pra hiṇmasi
verses.en: If ye be girt about with clouds of darkness, bound as ith a net. We rend and tear all witcheries hence and to their maker send them back.

verses.sa:
कृत्याकृतो वलगिनोऽभिनिष्कारिणः प्रजाम्।
मृणीहि कृत्ये मोच्छिषोऽमून् कृत्याकृतो जहि॥
verses.tr: kṛtyākṛto valagino'bhiniṣkāriṇaḥ prajām mṛṇīhi kṛtye mocchiṣo'mūn kṛtyākṛto jahi
verses.en: The brood of wizard, sorcerer, the pur poser of evil deed. Crush thou, O Kritya; spare not, kill those practisers of magic arts.

verses.sa:
यथा सूर्यो मुच्यते तमसस्परि रात्रिं जहात्युषसश्च केतून्।
एवाहं सर्वं दुर्भूतं कर्त्रं कृत्याकृता कृतं हस्तीव रजो दुरितं जहामि॥
verses.tr: yathā sūryo mucyate tamasaspari rātriṃ jahātyuṣasaśca ketūn evāhaṃ sarvaṃ durbhūtaṃ kartraṃ kṛtyākṛtā kṛtaṃ hastīva rajo duritaṃ jahāmi
verses.en: As Surya frees himself from depth of darkness, and casts away the night and rays of morning, So I repel each baleful charm which an enchanter hath prepared; And, as an elephant shakes off the dust, I oast the plague aside.

sections.label: Purusha, Primeval Man or Humanity personified
sections.name: Book 10, hymn 2

verses.sa:
केन पार्ष्णी आभृते पूरुषस्य केन मांसं संभृतं केन गुल्फौ।
केनाङ्गुलीः पेशनीः केन खानि केनोच्छ्लङ्खौ मध्यतः कः प्रतिष्ठाम्॥
verses.tr: kena pārṣṇī ābhṛte pūruṣasya kena māṃsaṃ saṃbhṛtaṃ kena gulphau kenāṅgulīḥ peśanīḥ kena khāni kenocchlaṅkhau madhyataḥ kaḥ pratiṣṭhām
verses.en: Who framed the heels of Purusha? Who fashioned the flesh of him? Who formed and fixed his ankles? i Who made the openings and well-moulded fingers? Who gave him foot-soles and a central station?

verses.sa:
कस्मान्नु गुल्फावधरावकृण्वन्नष्ठीवन्तावुत्तरौ पुरुषस्य ।
जङ्घे निरऋत्य न्यऽदधुः क्वऽस्विज्जानुनोः संधी क उ तच्चिकेत॥
verses.tr: kasmānnu gulphāvadharāvakṛṇvannaṣṭhīvantāvuttarau puruṣasya jaṅghe niraṛtya nya'dadhuḥ kva'svijjānunoḥ saṃdhī ka u tacciketa
verses.en: Whence did they make the ankles that are under, and the knee-bones of Purusha above them? What led them onward to the legs' construction? Who planned and formed the knees' articulations?

verses.sa:
चतुष्टयं युज्यते संहितान्तं जानुभ्यामूर्ध्वं शिथिरं कबन्धम्।
श्रोणी यदूरू क उ तज्जजान याभ्यां कुसिन्धं सुदृढं बभूव॥
verses.tr: catuṣṭayaṃ yujyate saṃhitāntaṃ jānubhyāmūrdhvaṃ śithiraṃ kabandham śroṇī yadūrū ka u tajjajāna yābhyāṃ kusindhaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ babhūva
verses.en: A fourfold frame is fixt with ends fc connected, and up above the knees a yielding belly. The hips and thighs, who was their generator, those props whereby the trunk grew firmly stablished?

verses.sa:
कति देवाः कतमे त आसन् य उरो ग्रीवाश्चिक्युः पुरुषस्य ।
कति स्तनौ व्यऽदधुः कः कफोडौ कति स्कन्धान् कति पृष्टीरचिन्वन्॥
verses.tr: kati devāḥ katame ta āsan ya uro grīvāścikyuḥ puruṣasya kati stanau vya'dadhuḥ kaḥ kaphoḍau kati skandhān kati pṛṣṭīracinvan
verses.en: Who and how many were those Gods who fastened the chest of Purusha and neck together? How many fixed his breasts? Who formed his elbows? How many joined together ribs and shoulders?

verses.sa:
को अस्य बाहू समभरद् वीर्यं करवादिति ।
अंसौ को अस्य तद् देवः कुसिन्धे अध्या दधौ॥
verses.tr: ko asya bāhū samabharad vīryaṃ karavāditi aṃsau ko asya tad devaḥ kusindhe adhyā dadhau
verses.en: Who put together both his arms and said, Let him show manly strength? Who and what God was he who set the shoulder-blades upon the trunk?

verses.sa:
कः सप्त खानि वि ततर्द शीर्षाणि कर्णाविमौ नासिके चक्षणी मुखम्।
येषां पुरुत्रा विजयस्य मह्ननि चतुष्पादो द्विपदो यन्ति यामम्॥
verses.tr: kaḥ sapta khāni vi tatarda śīrṣāṇi karṇāvimau nāsike cakṣaṇī mukham yeṣāṃ purutrā vijayasya mahnani catuṣpādo dvipado yanti yāmam
verses.en: Who pierced the seven openings in the head? Who made these ears, these nostrils, eyes, and mouth, Through whose surpassing might in all directions bipeds and quadrupeds have power of motion?

verses.sa:
हन्वोर्हि जिह्वामदधात् पुरूचीमधा महीमधि शिश्राय वाचम्।
स आ वरीवर्ति भुवनेष्वन्तरपो वसानः क उ तच्चिकेत॥
verses.tr: hanvorhi jihvāmadadhāt purūcīmadhā mahīmadhi śiśrāya vācam sa ā varīvarti bhuvaneṣvantarapo vasānaḥ ka u tacciketa
verses.en: He set within the jaws the tongue that reaches far, and thereon placed Speech the mighty Goddess. He wanders to and fro mid living creatures, robed in the waters. Who hath understood it?

verses.sa:
मस्तिष्कमस्य यतमो ललाटं ककाटिकां प्रथमो यः कपालम्।
चित्वा चित्यं हन्वोः पूरुषस्य दिवं रुरोह कतमः स देवः॥
verses.tr: mastiṣkamasya yatamo lalāṭaṃ kakāṭikāṃ prathamo yaḥ kapālam citvā cityaṃ hanvoḥ pūruṣasya divaṃ ruroha katamaḥ sa devaḥ
verses.en: Who was he, first, of all the Gods who fashioned his skull and brain and occiput and forehead, The pile that Purusha's two jaws supported? Who was that God who mounted up to heaven?

verses.sa:
प्रियाप्रियाणि बहुला स्वप्नं संबाधतन्द्यः ।
आनन्दानुग्रो नन्दांश्च कस्माद् वहति पूरुषः॥
verses.tr: priyāpriyāṇi bahulā svapnaṃ saṃbādhatandyaḥ ānandānugro nandāṃśca kasmād vahati pūruṣaḥ
verses.en: Whence bringeth mighty Purusha both pleasant and unpleasant things x Of varied sort, sleep, and alarm, fatigue, enjoyments and delights?

verses.sa:
आर्तिरवर्तिर्निरृतिः कुतो नु पुरुषेऽमतिः ।
राद्धिः समृद्धिरव्यृद्धिर्मतिरुदितयः कुतः॥
verses.tr: ārtiravartirnirṛtiḥ kuto nu puruṣe'matiḥ rāddhiḥ samṛddhiravyṛddhirmatiruditayaḥ kutaḥ
verses.en: Whence is there found in Purusha want, evil, suffering, distress? Whence come success, prosperity, opulence, thought, and utterance?

verses.sa:
को अस्मिन्नापो व्यऽदधाद् विषूवृतः पुरूवृतः सिन्धुसृत्याय जाताः ।
तीव्रा अरुणा लोहिनीस्ताम्रधूम्रा ऊर्ध्वा अवाचीः पुरुषे तिरश्चीः॥
verses.tr: ko asminnāpo vya'dadhād viṣūvṛtaḥ purūvṛtaḥ sindhusṛtyāya jātāḥ tīvrā aruṇā lohinīstāmradhūmrā ūrdhvā avācīḥ puruṣe tiraścīḥ
verses.en: Who stored in him floods turned in all directions, moving diverse and formed to flow in rivers, Hasty, red, copper-hued, and purple, running all ways in Purusha, upward and downward?

verses.sa:
को अस्मिन् रूपमदधात् को मह्मानं च नाम च ।
गातुं को अस्मिन् कः केतुं कश्चरित्राणि पूरुषे॥
verses.tr: ko asmin rūpamadadhāt ko mahmānaṃ ca nāma ca gātuṃ ko asmin kaḥ ketuṃ kaścaritrāṇi pūruṣe
verses.en: Who gave him visible form and shape? Who gave him magnitude and name? Who gave him motion, consciousness? Who furnished Purusha with feet?

verses.sa:
को अस्मिन् प्राणमवयत् को अपानं व्यानमु ।
समानमस्मिन् को देवोऽधि शिश्राय पुरुषे॥
verses.tr: ko asmin prāṇamavayat ko apānaṃ vyānamu samānamasmin ko devo'dhi śiśrāya puruṣe
verses.en: Who wove the vital air in him, who filled him with the downward breath? What God bestowed on Purusha the general pervading air?

verses.sa:
को अस्मिन् यज्ञमदधादेको देवोऽधि पुरुषे ।
को अस्मिन्त्सत्यं कोऽनृतं कुतो मृत्यृः कुतोऽमृतम्॥
verses.tr: ko asmin yajñamadadhādeko devo'dhi puruṣe ko asmintsatyaṃ ko'nṛtaṃ kuto mṛtyṛḥ kuto'mṛtam
verses.en: What God, what only Deity placed sacrifice in Purusha? l Who gave him truth and falsehood? Whence came Death and immortality?

verses.sa:
को अस्मै वासः पर्यदधात् को अस्यायुरकल्पयत्।
बलं को अस्मै प्रायच्छत् को अस्याकल्पयज्जवम्॥
verses.tr: ko asmai vāsaḥ paryadadhāt ko asyāyurakalpayat balaṃ ko asmai prāyacchat ko asyākalpayajjavam
verses.en: Who wrapped a garment round him? Who arranged the life he hath to live? Who granted him the boon of speech? Who gave this fleetness to his feet?

verses.sa:
केनापो अन्वतनुत केनाहरकरोद् रुचे।
उषसं केनान्वैन्द्ध केन सायंभवं ददे॥
verses.tr: kenāpo anvatanuta kenāharakarod ruce uṣasaṃ kenānvainddha kena sāyaṃbhavaṃ dade
verses.en: Through whom did he spread waters out, through whom did he make Day to shine? "Through whom did he enkindle Dawn and give the l gift of eventide?

verses.sa:
को अस्मिन् रेतो न्यऽदधात् तन्तुरा तायतामिति ।
मेधां को अस्मिन्नध्यौहत् को बाणं को नृतो दधौ॥
verses.tr: ko asmin reto nya'dadhāt tanturā tāyatāmiti medhāṃ ko asminnadhyauhat ko bāṇaṃ ko nṛto dadhau
verses.en: Who set the seed in him and said, Still be the thread of life spun out? Who gave him intellect besides? Who gave him voice and gestie power?

verses.sa:
केनेमां भूमिमौर्णोत् केन पर्यभवद् दिवम्।
केनाभि मह्ना पर्वतान् केन कर्माणि पुरुषः॥
verses.tr: kenemāṃ bhūmimaurṇot kena paryabhavad divam kenābhi mahnā parvatān kena karmāṇi puruṣaḥ
verses.en: Through whom did he bedeck the earth, through whom did he encompass heaven? Whose might made Purusha surpass the mountains and created things?

verses.sa:
केन पर्जन्यमन्वेति केन सोमं विचक्षणम्।
केन यज्ञं च श्रद्धां च केनास्मिन् निहितं मनः॥
verses.tr: kena parjanyamanveti kena somaṃ vicakṣaṇam kena yajñaṃ ca śraddhāṃ ca kenāsmin nihitaṃ manaḥ
verses.en: Through whom seeks he Parjanya out, and Soma of the piercing sight? Through whom belief and sacrifice? Through whom was spirit laid in him?

verses.sa:
केन श्रोत्रियमाप्नोति केनेमं परमेष्ठिनम्।
केनेममग्निं पूरुषः केन संवत्सरं ममे॥
verses.tr: kena śrotriyamāpnoti kenemaṃ parameṣṭhinam kenemamagniṃ pūruṣaḥ kena saṃvatsaraṃ mame
verses.en: What leads him to the learned priest? What leads him to this Lord Supreme? How doth he gain this Agni? By whom hath he measured out the year?

verses.sa:
ब्रह्म श्रोत्रियमाप्नोति ब्रह्मेमं परमेष्ठिनम्।
ब्रह्मेममग्निं पूरुषो ब्रह्म संवत्सरं ममे॥
verses.tr: brahma śrotriyamāpnoti brahmemaṃ parameṣṭhinam brahmemamagniṃ pūruṣo brahma saṃvatsaraṃ mame
verses.en: He, Brahma, gains the learned priest, he Brahma, gains this Lord Supreme. As Brahma, Man wins Agni here, Brahma hath measured out the year.

verses.sa:
केन देवाँ अनु क्षियति केन दैवजनीर्विशः ।
केनेदमन्यन्नक्षत्रं केन सत्क् क्षत्रमुच्यते॥
verses.tr: kena devāṃ anu kṣiyati kena daivajanīrviśaḥ kenedamanyannakṣatraṃ kena satk kṣatramucyate
verses.en: Through whom doth he abide with Gods? Through whom with the Celestial Tribes? Why is this other called a star? Why is this called the Real Power?

verses.sa:
ब्रह्म देवाँ अनु क्षियति ब्रह्म दैवजनीर्विशः ।
ब्रह्मेदमन्यन्नक्षत्रं ब्रह्म सत् क्षत्रमुच्यते॥
verses.tr: brahma devāṃ anu kṣiyati brahma daivajanīrviśaḥ brahmedamanyannakṣatraṃ brahma sat kṣatramucyate
verses.en: Brahma inhabits with the Gods, Brahma among the Heavenly Tribes, Brahma this other star is called, Brahma is called the Real Power.

verses.sa:
केनेयं भूमिर्विहिता केन द्यौरुत्तरा हिता।
केनेदमूर्ध्वं तिर्यक् चान्तरिक्षं व्यचो हितम्॥
verses.tr: keneyaṃ bhūmirvihitā kena dyauruttarā hitā kenedamūrdhvaṃ tiryak cāntarikṣaṃ vyaco hitam
verses.en: By whom was this our earth disposed? By whom was heaven placed over it? By whom was this expanse of air raised up on high and stretched across?

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मणा भूमिर्विहिता ब्रह्म द्यौरुत्तरा हिता।
ब्रह्मेदमूर्ध्वं तिर्यक् चान्तरिक्षं व्यचो हितम्॥
verses.tr: brahmaṇā bhūmirvihitā brahma dyauruttarā hitā brahmedamūrdhvaṃ tiryak cāntarikṣaṃ vyaco hitam
verses.en: By Brahma was this'earth disposed: Brahma is sky arranged above. Brahma is this expanse of air lifted on high and stretched across.

verses.sa:
मूर्धानमस्य संसीव्याथर्वा हृदयं च यत्।
मस्तिष्कादूर्ध्वः प्रैरयत् पवमानोऽधि शीर्षतः॥
verses.tr: mūrdhānamasya saṃsīvyātharvā hṛdayaṃ ca yat mastiṣkādūrdhvaḥ prairayat pavamāno'dhi śīrṣataḥ
verses.en: Together, with his needle hath Atharvan sewn his head and heart, And Pavamana hovered from his head on high above his brain,

verses.sa:
तद् वा अथर्वणः शिरो देवकोशः समुब्जितः ।
तत् प्राणो अभि रक्षति शिरो अन्नमथो मनः॥
verses.tr: tad vā atharvaṇaḥ śiro devakośaḥ samubjitaḥ tat prāṇo abhi rakṣati śiro annamatho manaḥ
verses.en: That is indeed Atharvan's head, the well-closed casket of the Gods. Spirit and Food and Vital Air protect that head from injury.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वो नु सृष्टा३स्तिर्यङ् नु सृष्टाः३ सर्वा दिशः पुरुष आ बभूवाँ३ ।
पुरं यो ब्रह्मणो वेद यस्याः पुरुष उच्यते॥
verses.tr: ūrdhvo nu sṛṣṭā3stiryaṅ nu sṛṣṭāḥ3 sarvā diśaḥ puruṣa ā babhūvāṃ3 puraṃ yo brahmaṇo veda yasyāḥ puruṣa ucyate
verses.en: Stationed on high, Purusha hath pervaded all regions spread aloft and stretched transversely, He who knows Brahma's cattle, yea, the fort whence Purusha is named,

verses.sa:
यो वै तां ब्रह्मणो वेदामृतेनावृतां पुरम्।
तस्मै ब्रह्म च ब्राह्माश्च चक्षुः प्राणं प्रजां ददुः॥
verses.tr: yo vai tāṃ brahmaṇo vedāmṛtenāvṛtāṃ puram tasmai brahma ca brāhmāśca cakṣuḥ prāṇaṃ prajāṃ daduḥ
verses.en: Yea, knows that fort of Brahma girt about with immortality, Brahma and Brahmas have bestowed sight, progeny, and life on him,

verses.sa:
न वै तं चक्षुर्जहाति न प्राणो जरसः पुरा।
पुरं यो ब्रह्मणो वेद यस्याः पुरुष उच्यते॥
verses.tr: na vai taṃ cakṣurjahāti na prāṇo jarasaḥ purā puraṃ yo brahmaṇo veda yasyāḥ puruṣa ucyate
verses.en: Sight leaves him not, breath quits not him before life's natural decay, Who knows the fort of Brahma, yea, the fort whence Parusha is named,

verses.sa:
अष्टाचक्रा नवद्वारा देवानां पूरयोध्या।
तस्यां हिरण्ययः कोशः स्वर्गो ज्योतिषावृतः॥
verses.tr: aṣṭācakrā navadvārā devānāṃ pūrayodhyā tasyāṃ hiraṇyayaḥ kośaḥ svargo jyotiṣāvṛtaḥ
verses.en: The fort of Gods, impregnable, with circles eight and portals nine, Contains a golden treasure-chest, celestial, begirt with light,

verses.sa:
तस्मिन् हिरण्यये कोशे त्र्यऽरे त्रिप्रतिष्ठिते ।
तस्मिन् यद् यक्षमात्मन्वत् तद् वै ब्रह्मविदो विदुः॥
verses.tr: tasmin hiraṇyaye kośe trya're tripratiṣṭhite tasmin yad yakṣamātmanvat tad vai brahmavido viduḥ
verses.en: Men deep in lore of Brahma know that Animated Being which Dwells in the golden treasure-chest that hath three. spokes and three supports.

verses.sa:
प्रभ्राजमानां हरिणीं यशसा संपरीवृताम्।
पुरं हिरण्ययीं ब्रह्मा विवेशापराजिताम्॥
verses.tr: prabhrājamānāṃ hariṇīṃ yaśasā saṃparīvṛtām puraṃ hiraṇyayīṃ brahmā viveśāparājitām
verses.en: Brahma hath passed within the fort, the golden castle; ne'er subdued, Bright with excessive brilliancy, compassed with glory round about,

sections.label: A charm to secure long life, health, prosperity, and Lime
sections.name: Book 10, hymn 3

verses.sa:
अयं मे वरणो मणिः सपत्नक्षयणो वृषा ।
तेना रभस्व त्वं शत्रून् प्र मृणीहि दुरस्यतः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ me varaṇo maṇiḥ sapatnakṣayaṇo vṛṣā tenā rabhasva tvaṃ śatrūn pra mṛṇīhi durasyataḥ
verses.en: Here is my charm the Varana, slayer of rivals, strong in act, With this grasp thou thine enemies, crush those who fain would injure thee,

verses.sa:
प्रैणान्छृणीहि प्र मृणा रभस्व मणिस्ते अस्तु पुरएता पुरस्तात्।
अवारयन्त वरणेन देवा अभ्याचारमसुराणां श्वःश्वः॥
verses.tr: praiṇānchṛṇīhi pra mṛṇā rabhasva maṇiste astu puraetā purastāt avārayanta varaṇena devā abhyācāramasurāṇāṃ śvaḥśvaḥ
verses.en: Break them in pieces; grasp them and destroy them. This Amulet shall go before and lead thee, With Varana the Gods, from morn to morning, have warded off the Asuras' enchantment.

verses.sa:
अयं मणिर्वरणो विश्वभेषजः सहस्राक्षो हरितो हिरण्ययः ।
स ते शत्रूनधरान् पादयाति पूर्वस्तान् दभ्नुहि ये त्वा द्विषन्ति॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ maṇirvaraṇo viśvabheṣajaḥ sahasrākṣo harito hiraṇyayaḥ sa te śatrūnadharān pādayāti pūrvastān dabhnuhi ye tvā dviṣanti
verses.en: This charm, this Varana healeth all diseases, bright with a thousand eyes and golden glitter, This charm shall conquer and cast down thy foemen, Be thou the first to slay the men who hate thee,

verses.sa:
अयं ते कृत्यां विततां पौरुषेयादयं भयात्।
अयं त्वा सर्वस्मात् पापाद् वरणो वारयिष्यते॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ te kṛtyāṃ vitatāṃ pauruṣeyādayaṃ bhayāt ayaṃ tvā sarvasmāt pāpād varaṇo vārayiṣyate
verses.en: This will stay witchcraft wrought for thee, will guard thee from the fear of man: From all distress and misery this Varana will shield thee well,

verses.sa:
वरणो वारयाता अयं देवो वनस्पतिः ।
यक्ष्मो यो अस्मिन्नाविष्टस्तमु देवा अवीवरन्॥
verses.tr: varaṇo vārayātā ayaṃ devo vanaspatiḥ yakṣmo yo asminnāviṣṭastamu devā avīvaran
verses.en: Guard against ill of varied kind is Varana this heavenly Plant, The Gods have stayed and driven off Consumption which had seized this man.

verses.sa:
स्वप्नं सुप्त्वा यदि पश्यासि पापं मृगः सृतिं यति धावादजुष्टाम्।
परिक्षवाच्छकुनेः पापवादादयं मणिर्वरणो वारयिष्यते॥
verses.tr: svapnaṃ suptvā yadi paśyāsi pāpaṃ mṛgaḥ sṛtiṃ yati dhāvādajuṣṭām parikṣavācchakuneḥ pāpavādādayaṃ maṇirvaraṇo vārayiṣyate
verses.en: H in thy sleep thou see an evil vision, oft as the beast repeats his loathed approaches, This Amulet, this Varana will guard thee from sneeze, and from the bird's ill-omened message.

verses.sa:
अरात्यास्त्वा निरृत्या अभिचारादथो भयात्।
मृत्योरोजीयसो वधाद् वरणो वारयिष्यते॥
verses.tr: arātyāstvā nirṛtyā abhicārādatho bhayāt mṛtyorojīyaso vadhād varaṇo vārayiṣyate
verses.en: From Mischief, from Malignity, from incantation, from alarm, "From death, from stronger 'foeman's stroke the Varana will guard thee well.

verses.sa:
यन्मे माता यन्मे पिता भ्रातरो यच्च मे स्वा यदेनश्चकृमा वयम्।
ततो नो वारयिष्यतेऽयं देवो वनस्पतिः॥
verses.tr: yanme mātā yanme pitā bhrātaro yacca me svā yadenaścakṛmā vayam tato no vārayiṣyate'yaṃ devo vanaspatiḥ
verses.en: Each sinful act that we have done,—my mother, father, and my friends,—From all the guilt this heavenly Plant will be our guard and sure defence.

verses.sa:
वरणेन प्रव्यथिता भ्रातृव्या मे सबन्धवः ।
असूर्तं रजो अप्यगुस्ते यन्त्वधमं तमः॥
verses.tr: varaṇena pravyathitā bhrātṛvyā me sabandhavaḥ asūrtaṃ rajo apyaguste yantvadhamaṃ tamaḥ
verses.en: Affrighted by the Varana let my rivals near akin to me Pass to the region void of light: to deepest darkness let them go.

verses.sa:
अरिष्टोऽहमरिष्टगुरायुष्मान्त्सर्वपूरुषः ।
तं मायं वरणो मणिः परि पातु दिशोदिशः॥
अयं मे वरण उरसि राजा देवो वनस्पतिः ।
स मे शत्रून् वि बाधतामिन्द्रो दस्यूनिवासुरान्॥
verses.tr: ariṣṭo'hamariṣṭagurāyuṣmāntsarvapūruṣaḥ taṃ māyaṃ varaṇo maṇiḥ pari pātu diśodiśaḥ ayaṃ me varaṇa urasi rājā devo vanaspatiḥ sa me śatrūn vi bādhatāmindro dasyūnivāsurān
verses.en: Safe are my cattle, safe am I, long-lived with all my men around. This Varana, mine Amulet, shall guard me well on every side, On I This Varana is on my breast, the sovran, the celestial Plant, Let it afflict my foemen as Indra quelled fiends and Asuras.

verses.sa:
इमं बिभर्मि वरणमायुष्मान्छतशारदः ।
स मे राष्ट्रं च क्षत्रं च पशूनोजश्च मे दधत्॥
verses.tr: imaṃ bibharmi varaṇamāyuṣmānchataśāradaḥ sa me rāṣṭraṃ ca kṣatraṃ ca paśūnojaśca me dadhat
verses.en: Through hundred autumn seasons, long to live, I wear this Varana. May it bestow on me great strength, cattle, and royalty, and power.

verses.sa:
यथा वातो वनस्पतीन् वृक्षान् भनक्त्योजसा ।
एवा सपत्नान् मे भङ्ग्धि पूर्वान् जातां उतापरान् वरणस्त्वाभि रक्षतु॥
verses.tr: yathā vāto vanaspatīn vṛkṣān bhanaktyojasā evā sapatnān me bhaṅgdhi pūrvān jātāṃ utāparān varaṇastvābhi rakṣatu
verses.en: As with its might the wind breaks down the trees, the sovrans of the wood, So break and rend my rivals, born before me and born after, Let the Varana protect thee well.

verses.sa:
यथा वातश्चाग्निश्च वृक्षान् प्सातो वनस्पतीन्।
एवा सपत्नान् मे प्साहि पूर्वान् जातां उतापरान् वरणस्त्वाभि रक्षतु॥
verses.tr: yathā vātaścāgniśca vṛkṣān psāto vanaspatīn evā sapatnān me psāhi pūrvān jātāṃ utāparān varaṇastvābhi rakṣatu
verses.en: As Agni and the wind devour the trees, the sovrans of the wood, Even so devour my rivals, born before me and born after, Let the Varana protect thee well,

verses.sa:
यथा वातेन प्रक्षीणा वृक्षाः शेरे न्यऽर्पिताः ।
एवा सपत्नांस्त्वं मम प्र क्षिणीहि न्यऽर्पय पूर्वान्जातां
उतापरान् वरणस्त्वाभि रक्षतु॥
verses.tr: yathā vātena prakṣīṇā vṛkṣāḥ śere nya'rpitāḥ evā sapatnāṃstvaṃ mama pra kṣiṇīhi nya'rpaya pūrvānjātāṃ utāparān varaṇastvābhi rakṣatu
verses.en: As, shattered by the tempest, trees lie withering ruined on the ground, Thus overthrow my rivals thou, so crush them down and ruin them, those born before and after Let this Varana protect thee well,

verses.sa:
तांस्त्वं प्र च्छिन्द्धि वरण पुरा दिष्टात् पुरायुषः ।
य एनं पशुषु दिप्सन्ति ये चास्य राष्ट्रदिप्सवः॥
verses.tr: tāṃstvaṃ pra cchinddhi varaṇa purā diṣṭāt purāyuṣaḥ ya enaṃ paśuṣu dipsanti ye cāsya rāṣṭradipsavaḥ
verses.en: Cut them in pieces, Varana! before their destined term of life, Those who would hurt his cattle, those who fain would harm the realm he rules.

verses.sa:
यथा सूर्यो अतिभाति यथास्मिन् तेज आहितम्।
एवा मे वरणो मणिः कीर्तिं भूतिं नि यच्छतु
तेजसा मा समुक्षतु यशसा समनक्तु मा॥
verses.tr: yathā sūryo atibhāti yathāsmin teja āhitam evā me varaṇo maṇiḥ kīrtiṃ bhūtiṃ ni yacchatu tejasā mā samukṣatu yaśasā samanaktu mā
verses.en: As Surya shines with brightest sheen, as splendour hath been stored in him, So may the Charm, the Varana, give me prosperity and fame. With lustre let it sprinkle me, and balm me with magnificence,

verses.sa:
यथा यशश्चन्द्रमस्यादित्ये च नृचक्षसि ।
एवा मे वरणो मणिः कीर्तिं भूतिं नि यच्छतु
तेजसा मा समुक्षतु यशसा समनक्तु मा॥
verses.tr: yathā yaśaścandramasyāditye ca nṛcakṣasi evā me varaṇo maṇiḥ kīrtiṃ bhūtiṃ ni yacchatu tejasā mā samukṣatu yaśasā samanaktu mā
verses.en: As glory dwelleth in the Moon and in the Sun who vieweth men, So may the Charm, etc.

verses.sa:
यथा यशः पृथिव्यां यथास्मिन् जातवेदसि ।
एवा मे वरणो मणिः कीर्तिं भूतिं नि यच्छतु
तेजसा मा समुक्षतु यशसा समनक्तु मा॥
verses.tr: yathā yaśaḥ pṛthivyāṃ yathāsmin jātavedasi evā me varaṇo maṇiḥ kīrtiṃ bhūtiṃ ni yacchatu tejasā mā samukṣatu yaśasā samanaktu mā
verses.en: As glory dwelleth in the Earth, and in this Jatavedas here, i So may the Charm, etc.

verses.sa:
यथा यशः कन्याऽयां यथास्मिन्त्संभृते रथे ।
एवा मे वरणो मणिः कीर्तिं भूतिं नि यच्छतु
तेजसा मा समुक्षतु यशसा समनक्तु मा॥
verses.tr: yathā yaśaḥ kanyā'yāṃ yathāsmintsaṃbhṛte rathe evā me varaṇo maṇiḥ kīrtiṃ bhūtiṃ ni yacchatu tejasā mā samukṣatu yaśasā samanaktu mā
verses.en: As glory dwelleth ina maid, and in this well-constructed car, So may the Charm, etc.

verses.sa:
यथा यशः सोमपीथे मधुपर्के यथा यशः ।
एवा मे वरणो मणिः कीर्तिं भूतिं नि यच्छतु
तेजसा मा समुक्षतु यशसा समनक्तु मा॥
verses.tr: yathā yaśaḥ somapīthe madhuparke yathā yaśaḥ evā me varaṇo maṇiḥ kīrtiṃ bhūtiṃ ni yacchatu tejasā mā samukṣatu yaśasā samanaktu mā
verses.en: As glory dwelleth in the draught of Soma and the honeyed drink, So may the Charm, etc.

verses.sa:
यथा यशोऽग्निहोत्रे वषट्कारे यथा यशः ।
एवा मे वरणो मणिः कीर्तिं भूतिं नि यच्छतु
तेजसा मा समुक्षतु यशसा समनक्तु मा॥
verses.tr: yathā yaśo'gnihotre vaṣaṭkāre yathā yaśaḥ evā me varaṇo maṇiḥ kīrtiṃ bhūtiṃ ni yacchatu tejasā mā samukṣatu yaśasā samanaktu mā
verses.en: As glory dwells in sacrifice to Agni, and the hallowing word, So may the Charm, etc.

verses.sa:
यथा यशो यजमाने यथास्मिन् यज्ञ आहितम्।
एवा मे वरणो मणिः कीर्तिं भूतिं नि यच्छतु
तेजसा मा समुक्षतु यशसा समनक्तु मा॥
verses.tr: yathā yaśo yajamāne yathāsmin yajña āhitam evā me varaṇo maṇiḥ kīrtiṃ bhūtiṃ ni yacchatu tejasā mā samukṣatu yaśasā samanaktu mā
verses.en: As glory is bestowed upon the patron and this sacrifice, So may the Charm, etc.

verses.sa:
यथा यशः प्रजापतौ यथास्मिन् परमेष्ठिनि ।
एवा मे वरणो मणिः कीर्तिं भूतिं नि यच्छतु
तेजसा मा समुक्षतु यशसा समनक्तु मा॥
verses.tr: yathā yaśaḥ prajāpatau yathāsmin parameṣṭhini evā me varaṇo maṇiḥ kīrtiṃ bhūtiṃ ni yacchatu tejasā mā samukṣatu yaśasā samanaktu mā
verses.en: As glory dwelleth in the Lord of Life and in this God Supreme, So may the Charm, etc.

verses.sa:
यथा देवेष्वमृतं यथैषु सत्यमाहितम्।
एवा मे वरणो मणिः कीर्तिं भूतिं नि यच्छतु
तेजसा मा समुक्षतु यशसा समनक्तु मा॥
verses.tr: yathā deveṣvamṛtaṃ yathaiṣu satyamāhitam evā me varaṇo maṇiḥ kīrtiṃ bhūtiṃ ni yacchatu tejasā mā samukṣatu yaśasā samanaktu mā
verses.en: As immortality and truth have been established in the Gods, So may the Charm, the Varana, give me prosperity and fame. With lustre let it sprinkle me, and balm me with magnificence.

sections.label: A charm to destroy venomous serpents
sections.name: Book 10, hymn 4

verses.en: The first of all is Indra's car, next is the chariot of the Gods, the third is Varuna' s alone. The last, the Serpents' chariot, struck the pillar and then sped away.
Their lustre is the Darbha-grass, its young shoots are their horse's tail: the reed's plume is their chariot-seat.
Strike out, white courser! with thy foot, strike both with fore and hinder foot, Stay the dire poison of the Snakes, and make it weak as soaking wood.
Loud neighing he hath dived below, and rising up again replied, Stayed the dire poison of the Snakes, and made it weak as soaking wood,
Paidva kills Kasarnila, kills both the white Serpent and the black. Paidva hath struck and cleft in twain Ratharvi's and the Viper'. head.
Go onward, horse of Pedu! go thou first: we follow after thee, Cast thou aside the Serpents from the pathwry whereupon we tread.
Here was the horse of Pedu born: this is the way that takes him hence. These are the tracks the courser left, the mighty slayer of the Snakes.
Let him not close the opened mouth, nor open that which now is closed, Two snakes are in this field, and both, female and male, are powerless,
Powerless are the serpents here, those that are near and those afar. I kill the scorpion with a club, and with a staff the new-come snake,
This is the remedy against Aghasva and the adder, both: Indra and Paidva have subdued and tamed the vicious snake for me, i
We fix our thoughts on Pedu's horse, strong, off spring of a atedfa st line. Behind our backs the vipers here crouch down and line in wait for us,
Bereft of life and poison they lie slain by bolt-armed Indra's hand, Indra and we have slogutered them,
Tiraschirajis have been slain, ond vipers crushed and brayed to bits. Slay Darvi in the Darbha-grass, Karikrata, and-White and Black.
The young maid of Kirata race, a little damsel, digs the drug, Digs it with shovels wrought of gold on the high ridges of the hills,
Hither the young unconquered leech who slays the speckled snake hath come, He verily demolishes adder and scorpion; both of them.
Indra, Mitra and Varuna, and Vata and Parjanya 'both have given the serpent up to me.
Indra hath given him up to me, the female viper and the male, The adder, him with stripes athwart, Kasarpila, Dasonasi,
O Serpent, Indra hath destroyed the sire who first. engendered thee: En And when these snakes are pierced and bored what; sap and vigour will be theirs?
Their heads have I seized firmly as a fisher grasps tha spotted prey, Waded half through the stream and washed the poison of the serpents off.
Let the floods hurry on and bear the poison of all snakes afar. Tiraschirajis have been slain and vipers crushed and f r brayed to bits. "21 s from
the salutary plants I deftly pick the fibres out, And guide them skilfully like mares, so let thy venom, Snake! depart,
All poison that the sun and fire, all that the earth and plants contain, Poison of most effectual power—let all thy venom pass away.
Serpents which fire or plants have generated, those which have sprung from waters or the lightning, Whose mighty broods are found in many places, these serpents we will reverently worship.
Thou art a maid called Taudi, or Ghritach? is thy name. Thy place Is underneath my foot. I take the poison-killing remedy.
From every member drive away the venom, and avoid the heart. Then let the poison's burning heat pass downward and away from thee.
The bane hath fled afar. It wept, and asked the poison how it fared,
Agni hath found the venom of the serpent, Soma drawn it out, Back to the biter hath returned the poison, and the snake hath died, l

sections.label: A charm to overthrow a rival and gain strength, dignity, long life
sections.name: Book 10, hymn 5

verses.en: Ye are the power of Indra, ye the force and strength of Indra, ye his hero might and manliness, I join you with the bonds of Prayer to the victorious enterprise.
For the victorious enterprise let all creation stand by me. For me ye, Waters, are prepared,
Ye are the share of Agni, Grant, O heavenly Waters unto us the Waters' brilliant energy. By statute of Prajapati I set you down for this our world.

Waters, your ceremonial share of Waters which the waters hold, which aids our sacrifice to Gods, This as a remnant here I leave. Do not thou wash it clean away, With this we let the man go by who hates us and whom we abhor. Him would I fain o'erthrow and slay with this our ceremonial act, with this our prayer, our thunderbolt.
Whatever evil I have done within this last From all that woe and misery let the waters shield and guard me well,
Odward I urge your gathered floods: enter your own abiding -plaee, Uninjured and with all your strength. Let nothing bend or bow us down.
May the pure Waters cleanse us from defilement, Fair to behold remove our sin and trouble, and bear away ill-dream and all pollution.
Thou art the step of Vishnu, rival-slayer, sharpened by earth, aglow with fire of Agni, Earth have I ranged: from earth we bar him who hates us and whom we hate.
Ours is superior place and ours is conquest: may I in all fights tread down spite and malice. Let him. not live, let vital breath desert him.
With this I here invest the power and splendour, the life of that man and his vital breathing, the son of such a sire and such a woman, here do I overthrow and cast him downward.
I follow Surya's course in heaven, the course that takes him to the South. May that bestow upon me wealth and glory ofa Brahman's rank.
I turn me to the regions bright with splendour. May they bestow upon me wealth and glory of a Brahman's rank,
I turn me to the Rishis Seven, May they, etc.
I turn me unto Prayer. May that, etc.
I turn me unto Brahmans. May they etc.
We hunt that man, we beat him down and slay him with our murderous blows. We with the spell have hurried him to Parameshthin's opened jaws.
Let the shot missile catch him with Vaisvanara's two mighty fangs, i This offering, and the mightiest Goddess, the Fuel, eat him up!
Thou art the bound of Varuna the King. Bind, such an one, the son of such a woman, in vital breath and in the food that feeds him,
All food of thine, O Lord of Life, that lies, upon the face of earth, Thereof bestow thou upon us, O Lord of Life, Prajapati I
Celestial Waters have I sought: with: juice have I besprinkled them, With milk, O Agni, have I come: bestow upon me splendid strength,
Give me the boon of splendid strength; give, Agni! progeny and life. May the Gods know this prayer of mine, may Indra with the Rishis know.
What curse soever couples launch against us, whatever bitter speech the chatterers utter, With Manyu's arrow, offspring of the spirit, transfix thou to the heart the Yatudhanas.
Destroy the Yatudhanas with thy fervour, consume the demons with thy wrath, O Agni, Destroy the fool's gods with thy fiery splendour. destroy the blazing ones, the insatiable,
Well-skiled, against this man I hur! the Water's bolt with four spikes, to cleave his head asunder. May it destroy all members of his body, Let the whole host of Gods approve my purpose.

sections.label: The glorification of an all-powerful amulet
sections.name: Book 10, hymn 6

verses.sa: अरातीयोर्भ्रातृव्यस्य दुर्हार्दो द्विषतः शिरः । अपि वृश्चाम्योजसा॥
verses.tr: arātīyorbhrātṛvyasya durhārdo dviṣataḥ śiraḥ api vṛścāmyojasā
verses.en: power I cut away the head of my malignant rival, of mine evil-hearted enemy.

verses.sa:
वर्म मह्यमयं मणिः फालाज्जातः करिष्यति ।
पूर्णो मन्थेन मागमद् रसेन सह वर्चसा॥
verses.tr: varma mahyamayaṃ maṇiḥ phālājjātaḥ kariṣyati pūrṇo manthena māgamad rasena saha varcasā
verses.en: This Amulet of citron-wood shall make for me a trusty shield: Filled with the mingled beverage, with sap and vigour hath it come, l

verses.sa:
यत् त्वा शिक्वः परावधीत् तक्षा हस्तेन वास्या ।
आपस्त्वा तस्मज्जीवलाः पुनन्तु शुचयः शुचिम्॥
verses.tr: yat tvā śikvaḥ parāvadhīt takṣā hastena vāsyā āpastvā tasmajjīvalāḥ punantu śucayaḥ śucim
verses.en: What though the strong-armed carpenter have cleft. thee with his hand and axe. Pure animating waters shall cleanse thee and make thee bright again,

verses.sa: हिरण्यस्रगयं मणिः श्रद्धां यज्ञं महो दधत्। गृहे वसतु नोऽतिथिः॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyasragayaṃ maṇiḥ śraddhāṃ yajñaṃ maho dadhat gṛhe vasatu no'tithiḥ
verses.en: This Amulet, decked with chain of gold, shall give, faith, sacrifice, and might, and dwell as guest within our house.

verses.sa:
तस्मै घृतं सुरां मध्वन्नमन्नं क्षदामहे ।
स नः पितेव पुत्रेभ्यः श्रेयःश्रेयश्चिकित्सतु भूयोभूयः श्वःश्वो देवेभ्यो मणिरेत्य॥
verses.tr: tasmai ghṛtaṃ surāṃ madhvannamannaṃ kṣadāmahe sa naḥ piteva putrebhyaḥ śreyaḥśreyaścikitsatu bhūyobhūyaḥ śvaḥśvo devebhyo maṇiretya
verses.en: To this we give apportioned food, clarfied butter, wine, and meath. May it provide each boon for us as doth a father for his sons, Again, again, from morn to morn, having approached the deities.

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद् बृहस्पतिर्मणिं फालं घृतश्चुतमुग्रं खदिरमोजसे ।
तमग्निः प्रत्यमुञ्चत सो अस्मै दुह आज्यं भूयोभूयः श्वःश्वस्तेन त्वं द्विषतो जहि॥
verses.tr: yamabadhnād bṛhaspatirmaṇiṃ phālaṃ ghṛtaścutamugraṃ khadiramojase tamagniḥ pratyamuñcata so asmai duha ājyaṃ bhūyobhūyaḥ śvaḥśvastena tvaṃ dviṣato jahi
verses.en: The Charm Brihaspati hath bound, the fatness-dropping citron-wood, the potent Khadira, for strength, This Agni hath put on: it yields clarified butter for this man. Again, again, from morn to morn, With this subdue thine enemies,

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद् बृहस्पतिर्मणिं फालं घृतश्चुतमुग्रं खदिरमोजसे ।
तमिन्द्रः प्रत्यमुञ्चतौजसे वीर्याऽय कम्।
सो अस्मै बलमिद् दुहे भूयोभूयः श्वःश्वस्तेन त्वं द्विषतो जहि॥
verses.tr: yamabadhnād bṛhaspatirmaṇiṃ phālaṃ ghṛtaścutamugraṃ khadiramojase tamindraḥ pratyamuñcataujase vīryā'ya kam so asmai balamid duhe bhūyobhūyaḥ śvaḥśvastena tvaṃ dviṣato jahi
verses.en: The Charm Brihaspati hath bound, the fatness-dropping citron-wood, the potent Khadira, for strength, This Charm hath Indra put on him for power and manly puissance, It yieldeth strength to strengthen him, again, again, from morn to morn, having approached the deities,

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद् बृहस्पतिर्मणिं फालं घृतश्चुतमुग्रं खदिरमोजसे ।
तं सोमः प्रत्यमुञ्चत महे श्रोत्राय चक्षसे ।
सो अस्मै वर्च इद् दुहे भूयोभूयः श्वःश्वस्तेन त्वं द्विषतो जहि॥
verses.tr: yamabadhnād bṛhaspatirmaṇiṃ phālaṃ ghṛtaścutamugraṃ khadiramojase taṃ somaḥ pratyamuñcata mahe śrotrāya cakṣase so asmai varca id duhe bhūyobhūyaḥ śvaḥśvastena tvaṃ dviṣato jahi
verses.en: The Charm Brihaspati, etc. This Charm hath Soma put on him for might, for hearing, and for sight, This yields him energy indeed, again, etc,

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद् बृहस्पतिर्मणिं फालं घृतश्चुतमुग्रं खदिरमोजसे ।
तं सूर्यः प्रत्यमुञ्चत तेनेमा अजयद् दिशः ।
सो अस्मै भूतिमिद् दुहे भूयोभूयः श्वःश्वस्तेन त्वं द्विषतो जहि॥
verses.tr: yamabadhnād bṛhaspatirmaṇiṃ phālaṃ ghṛtaścutamugraṃ khadiramojase taṃ sūryaḥ pratyamuñcata tenemā ajayad diśaḥ so asmai bhūtimid duhe bhūyobhūyaḥ śvaḥśvastena tvaṃ dviṣato jahi
verses.en: The Charm Brihaspati, etc. This Surya put on him, with this conquered the regions of the sky, This yieldeth him ability, again, etc.

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद् बृहस्पतिर्मणिं फालं घृतश्चुतमुग्रं खदिरमोजसे ।
तं बिभ्रच्चन्द्रमा मणिमसुराणां पुरोऽजयद् दानवानां हिरण्ययीः ।
सो अस्मै श्रियमिद् दुहे भूयोभूयः श्वःश्वस्तेन त्वं द्विषतो जहि॥
verses.tr: yamabadhnād bṛhaspatirmaṇiṃ phālaṃ ghṛtaścutamugraṃ khadiramojase taṃ bibhraccandramā maṇimasurāṇāṃ puro'jayad dānavānāṃ hiraṇyayīḥ so asmai śriyamid duhe bhūyobhūyaḥ śvaḥśvastena tvaṃ dviṣato jahi
verses.en: The Charm Brihaspati, ete, This Charm did Chandra wear, with this conquered the forts of Asuras, the golden forts of Dauavas. This yields him glory and renown, again, etc.

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद् बृहस्पतिर्वाताय मणिमाशवे ।
सो अस्मै वाजिन दुहे भूयोभूयः श्वःश्वस्तेन त्वं द्विषतो जहि॥
verses.tr: yamabadhnād bṛhaspatirvātāya maṇimāśave so asmai vājina duhe bhūyobhūyaḥ śvaḥśvastena tvaṃ dviṣato jahi
verses.en: The Amulet Brihaspati bound on the swiftly-moving Wind, This yieldeth him a vigorous steed, again, etc,

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद् बृहस्पतिर्वाताय मणिमाशवे । तेनेमां मणिना कृषिमश्विनावभि रक्षतः ।
स भिषग्भ्यां महो दुहे भूयोभूयः श्वःश्वस्तेन त्वं द्विषतो जहि॥
verses.tr: yamabadhnād bṛhaspatirvātāya maṇimāśave tenemāṃ maṇinā kṛṣimaśvināvabhi rakṣataḥ sa bhiṣagbhyāṃ maho duhe bhūyobhūyaḥ śvaḥśvastena tvaṃ dviṣato jahi
verses.en: The Asvins with this Amulet protect this culture of our fields. This yields the two Physicians might, again, etc

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद् बृहस्पतिर्वाताय मणिमाशवे ।
तं बिभ्रत् सविता मणिं तेनेदमजयत् स्वः ।
सो अस्मै सूनृतां दुहे भूयोभूयः श्वःश्वस्तेन त्वं द्विषतो जहि॥
verses.tr: yamabadhnād bṛhaspatirvātāya maṇimāśave taṃ bibhrat savitā maṇiṃ tenedamajayat svaḥ so asmai sūnṛtāṃ duhe bhūyobhūyaḥ śvaḥśvastena tvaṃ dviṣato jahi
verses.en: Savitar wore this Amulet: herewith he won this lucid heaven. l This yields him glory and delight, again, etc.

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद् बृहस्पतिर्वाताय मणिमाशवे ।
तमापो बिभ्रतीर्मणिं सदा धावन्त्यक्षिताः ।
स आभ्योऽमृतमिद् दुहे भूयोभूयः श्वःश्वस्तेन त्वं द्विषतो जहि॥
verses.tr: yamabadhnād bṛhaspatirvātāya maṇimāśave tamāpo bibhratīrmaṇiṃ sadā dhāvantyakṣitāḥ sa ābhyo'mṛtamid duhe bhūyobhūyaḥ śvaḥśvastena tvaṃ dviṣato jahi
verses.en: Wearing thisCharm the Waters flow eternally inviolate. This yieldeth them ambrosia, again, etc.

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद् बृहस्पतिर्वाताय मणिमाशवे ।तं राजा वरुणो मणिं प्रत्यमुञ्चत शंभुवम्।
सो अस्मै सत्यमिद् दुहे भूयोभूयः श्वःश्वस्तेन त्वं द्विषतो जहि॥
verses.tr: yamabadhnād bṛhaspatirvātāya maṇimāśave taṃ rājā varuṇo maṇiṃ pratyamuñcata śaṃbhuvam so asmai satyamid duhe bhūyobhūyaḥ śvaḥśvastena tvaṃ dviṣato jahi
verses.en: King Varuna assumed and wore this salutary Amulet, This yieldeth him his truthfulness, again, etc.

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद् बृहस्पतिर्वाताय मणिमाशवे ।
तं देवा बिभ्रतो मणिं सर्वांल्लोकान् युधाजयन्।
स एभ्यो जितिमिद् दुहे भूयोभूयः श्वःश्वस्तेन त्वं द्विषतो जहि॥
verses.tr: yamabadhnād bṛhaspatirvātāya maṇimāśave taṃ devā bibhrato maṇiṃ sarvāṃllokān yudhājayan sa ebhyo jitimid duhe bhūyobhūyaḥ śvaḥśvastena tvaṃ dviṣato jahi
verses.en: Wearing this Amulet the Gods conquered in battle all the worlds. This yieldeth victory for them, again, etc.

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद् बृहस्पतिर्वाताय मणिमाशवे ।
तमिमं देवता मणिं प्रत्यमुञ्चन्त शंभुवम्।
स आभ्यो विश्वमिद् दुहे भूयोभूयः श्वःश्वस्तेन त्वं द्विषतो जहि॥
verses.tr: yamabadhnād bṛhaspatirvātāya maṇimāśave tamimaṃ devatā maṇiṃ pratyamuñcanta śaṃbhuvam sa ābhyo viśvamid duhe bhūyobhūyaḥ śvaḥśvastena tvaṃ dviṣato jahi
verses.en: The Amulet Brihaspati formed for the swiftly-moving Wind, This salutary Amulet the Deities assumed and wore, This yieldeth them the universe, again, again, from morn to morn, With this subdue thine enemies.

verses.sa: ऋतवस्तमबध्नतार्तवास्तमबध्नत । संवत्सरस्तं बद्ध्वा सर्वं भूतं वि रक्षति॥
verses.tr: ṛtavastamabadhnatārtavāstamabadhnata saṃvatsarastaṃ baddhvā sarvaṃ bhūtaṃ vi rakṣati
verses.en: The Seasons formed that Amulet, the Groups of Seasons fashioned ib, The Year having constructed it preserveth everything that is,

verses.sa:
अन्तर्देशा अबध्नत प्रदिशस्तमबध्नत ।
प्रजापतिसृष्टो मणिर्द्विषतो मेऽधराँ अकः॥
verses.tr: antardeśā abadhnata pradiśastamabadhnata prajāpatisṛṣṭo maṇirdviṣato me'dharāṃ akaḥ
verses.en: The regions of the heaven, the points that lie between them fashioned it, Created by Prajapati, may the Charm cast my foemen down.

verses.sa:
अथर्वाणो अबध्नताथर्वणा अबध्नत ।
तौर्मेदिनो अङ्गिरसो दस्यूनां बिभिदुः पुरस्तेन त्वं द्विषतो जहि॥
verses.tr: atharvāṇo abadhnatātharvaṇā abadhnata taurmedino aṅgiraso dasyūnāṃ bibhiduḥ purastena tvaṃ dviṣato jahi
verses.en: Atharvan made the Amulet, Atharvan's children fashioned it. With them the sage Angirases brake through the Dasyus' fortresses, With this subdue thine enemies,

verses.sa:
तं धाता प्रत्यमुञ्चत स भूतं व्यऽकल्पयत्।
तेन त्वं द्विषतो जहि॥
verses.tr: taṃ dhātā pratyamuñcata sa bhūtaṃ vya'kalpayat tena tvaṃ dviṣato jahi
verses.en: Dhatar bound on this Amulet: he ranged and ordered all that is. With this do thou subdue. thy foes,

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद् बृहस्पतिर्देवेभ्यो असुरक्षितिम्।
स मायं मणिरागमद् रसेन सह वर्चसा॥
verses.tr: yamabadhnād bṛhaspatirdevebhyo asurakṣitim sa māyaṃ maṇirāgamad rasena saha varcasā
verses.en: The Amulet Brihaspati formed for the Gods, that slew the fiends, That Amulet here hath come to me combined with sap and energy.

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद् बृहस्पतिर्देवेभ्यो असुरक्षितिम्।
स मायं मणिरागमत् सह गोभिरजाविभिरन्नेन प्रजया सह॥
verses.tr: yamabadhnād bṛhaspatirdevebhyo asurakṣitim sa māyaṃ maṇirāgamat saha gobhirajāvibhirannena prajayā saha
verses.en: The Amulet, etc. That Amulet here hath come to me, hath come with cows, and goats, and sheep, hath come with food and progeny,

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद् बृहस्पतिर्देवेभ्यो असुरक्षितिम्।
स मायं मणिरागमत् सह व्रीहियवाभ्यां महसा भूत्या सह॥
verses.tr: yamabadhnād bṛhaspatirdevebhyo asurakṣitim sa māyaṃ maṇirāgamat saha vrīhiyavābhyāṃ mahasā bhūtyā saha
verses.en: The Amulet, etc. That Amulet here hath come to me with store of barley and of rice, with greatness and prosperity.

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद् बृहस्पतिर्देवेभ्यो असुरक्षितिम्।
स मायं मणिरागमन्मधोर्घृतस्य धारया कीलालेन मणिः सह॥
verses.tr: yamabadhnād bṛhaspatirdevebhyo asurakṣitim sa māyaṃ maṇirāgamanmadhorghṛtasya dhārayā kīlālena maṇiḥ saha
verses.en: The Amulet, etc. That Amulet here hath come to me with streams of butter and of mead, with sweet delicious beverage,

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद् बृहस्पतिर्देवेभ्यो असुरक्षितिम्।
स मायं मणिरागमदूर्जया पयसा सह द्रविणेन श्रिया सह॥
verses.tr: yamabadhnād bṛhaspatirdevebhyo asurakṣitim sa māyaṃ maṇirāgamadūrjayā payasā saha draviṇena śriyā saha
verses.en: The Amulet, etc. That Amulet here hath come to me with power and, abundant strength, hath come with glory and with wealth,

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद् बृहस्पतिर्देवेभ्यो असुरक्षितिम्।
स मायं मणिरागमत् तेजसा त्विष्या सह यशसा कीर्त्याऽ सह॥
verses.tr: yamabadhnād bṛhaspatirdevebhyo asurakṣitim sa māyaṃ maṇirāgamat tejasā tviṣyā saha yaśasā kīrtyā' saha
verses.en: That Amulet, etc. That Amulet here hath come to me with splendour and a blaze of light, with honour and illustrious fame.

verses.sa:
यमबध्नाद् बृहस्पतिर्देवेभ्यो असुरक्षितिम्।
स मायं मणिरागमत् सर्वाभिर्भूतिभिः सह॥
verses.tr: yamabadhnād bṛhaspatirdevebhyo asurakṣitim sa māyaṃ maṇirāgamat sarvābhirbhūtibhiḥ saha
verses.en: The Amulet Brihaspati made for the Gods, that slew the fiends, That Amulet here hath come to me combined with all prosperities.

verses.sa:
तमिमं देवता मणिं मह्यं ददतु पुष्टये ।
अभिभुं क्षत्रवर्धनं सपत्नदम्भनं मणिम्॥
verses.tr: tamimaṃ devatā maṇiṃ mahyaṃ dadatu puṣṭaye abhibhuṃ kṣatravardhanaṃ sapatnadambhanaṃ maṇim
verses.en: That Amulet may the Deities bestow on me to win The conquering, strength-increasing Charm, the r of enemies.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मणा तेजसा सह प्रति मुञ्चामि मे शिवम्।
असपत्नः सपत्नहा सपत्नान् मेऽधरां अकः॥
verses.tr: brahmaṇā tejasā saha prati muñcāmi me śivam asapatnaḥ sapatnahā sapatnān me'dharāṃ akaḥ
verses.en: I bind on me my happy fate with holy prayer and energy. Foeless destroyer of the foe, it hath subdued mine enemies,

verses.sa:
उत्तरं द्विषतो मामयं मणिः कृणोतु देवजाः ।
यस्य लोका इमे त्रयः पयो दुग्धमुपासते ।
स मायमधि रोहतु मणिः श्रैष्ठ्याय मूर्धतः॥
verses.tr: uttaraṃ dviṣato māmayaṃ maṇiḥ kṛṇotu devajāḥ yasya lokā ime trayaḥ payo dugdhamupāsate sa māyamadhi rohatu maṇiḥ śraiṣṭhyāya mūrdhataḥ
verses.en: May this Charm, offspring of the Gods, make me superior to my foe. So may this Charm whose milk expressed these three worlds longingly await, Be fastened on me here, that it may crown me with surpassing power.

verses.sa:
यं देवाः पितरो मनुष्याऽ उपजीवन्ति सर्वदा।
स मायमधि रोहतु मणिः श्रैष्ठ्याय मूर्धतः॥
verses.tr: yaṃ devāḥ pitaro manuṣyā' upajīvanti sarvadā sa māyamadhi rohatu maṇiḥ śraiṣṭhyāya mūrdhataḥ
verses.en: The Charm to which men, Fathers, Gods look ever for their maintenance, May this be fastened on me here, to crown me with surpassing power,

verses.sa:
यथा बीजमुर्वरायां कृष्टे फालेन रोहति ।
एवा मयि प्रजा पशवोऽन्नमन्नं वि रोहतु॥
verses.tr: yathā bījamurvarāyāṃ kṛṣṭe phālena rohati evā mayi prajā paśavo'nnamannaṃ vi rohatu
verses.en: As, when the plough hath tilled the soil, the seed springs up in fertile land. Let cattle, progeny, and food of every kind spring up with me,

verses.sa:
यस्मै त्वा यज्ञवर्धन मणे प्रत्यमुचं शिवम्।
तं त्वं शतदक्षिण मणे श्रैष्ठ्याय जिन्वतात्॥
verses.tr: yasmai tvā yajñavardhana maṇe pratyamucaṃ śivam taṃ tvaṃ śatadakṣiṇa maṇe śraiṣṭhyāya jinvatāt
verses.en: Charm, forwarder of sacrifice, who hast a hundred priestly fees, Speed to preeminence him to whom I have attached thy happy fate.

verses.sa:
एतमिध्मं समाहितं जुषाणो अग्ने प्रति हर्य होमैः ।
तस्मिन् विदेम सुमतिं स्वस्ति प्रजां चक्षुः पशून्त्समिद्धे जातवेदसि ब्रह्मणा॥
verses.tr: etamidhmaṃ samāhitaṃ juṣāṇo agne prati harya homaiḥ tasmin videma sumatiṃ svasti prajāṃ cakṣuḥ paśūntsamiddhe jātavedasi brahmaṇā
verses.en: Love thou, O Agni, pleased with burnt oblations, this sacred fuel that is ranged in order. In him may we find grace and loving-kindness, happiness, progeny, and sight and cattle, in Jatavedas kindled with devotion... Hymn VII.

sections.label: Skambha, the Pillar or Fulcrum of all existence
sections.name: Book 10, hymn 7

verses.sa:
कस्मिन्नङ्गे तपो अस्याधि तिष्ठति कस्मिन्नङ्ग ऋतमस्याध्याहितम्।
क्वऽ व्रतं क्वऽ श्रद्धास्य तिष्ठति कस्मिन्नङ्गे सत्यमस्य प्रतिष्ठितम्॥
verses.tr: kasminnaṅge tapo asyādhi tiṣṭhati kasminnaṅga ṛtamasyādhyāhitam kva' vrataṃ kva' śraddhāsya tiṣṭhati kasminnaṅge satyamasya pratiṣṭhitam
verses.en: Which of his members is the seat of Fervour: Which is the base of Ceremonial Order? Where in him standeth Faith? Where Holy Duty? Where, in what part of him is Truth implanted?

verses.sa:
कस्मादङ्गाद् दीप्यते अग्निरस्य कस्मादङ्गात् पवते मातरिश्वा ।
कस्मादङ्गाद् वि मिमीतेऽधि चन्द्रमा मह स्कम्भस्य मिमानो अङ्गम्॥
verses.tr: kasmādaṅgād dīpyate agnirasya kasmādaṅgāt pavate mātariśvā kasmādaṅgād vi mimīte'dhi candramā maha skambhasya mimāno aṅgam
verses.en: Out of which member glows the light of Agni? Form which proceeds the breath of Matarigvan? l From which doth Chadra measure 'out his journey, travelling over Skambha's mighty body?

verses.sa:
कस्मिन्नङ्गे तिष्ठति भूमिरस्य कस्मिन्नङ्गे तिष्ठत्यन्तरिक्षम्।
कस्मिन्नङ्गे तिष्ठत्याहिता द्यौः कस्मिन्नङ्गे तिष्ठत्युत्तरं दिवः॥
verses.tr: kasminnaṅge tiṣṭhati bhūmirasya kasminnaṅge tiṣṭhatyantarikṣam kasminnaṅge tiṣṭhatyāhitā dyauḥ kasminnaṅge tiṣṭhatyuttaraṃ divaḥ
verses.en: Which of his members is the earth's upholder? Which gives the middle air a base to rest on? Where, in which member is the sky established? Where hath the space above the sky its dwelling?

verses.sa:
क्व१ प्रेप्सन् दीप्यत ऊर्ध्वो अग्निः क्व१प्रेप्सन् पवते मातरिश्वा ।
यत्र प्रेप्सन्तीरभियन्त्यावृतः स्कम्भं तं ब्रूहि कतमः स्विदेव सः॥
verses.tr: kva1 prepsan dīpyata ūrdhvo agniḥ kva1prepsan pavate mātariśvā yatra prepsantīrabhiyantyāvṛtaḥ skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svideva saḥ
verses.en: Whitherward yearning blazeth Agni upward? Whitherward yearning bloweth Matarisvan? Who out of many, tell me, is that Skambha to whom with longing go the turning pathways?

verses.sa:
क्वाऽर्धमासाः क्वऽ यन्ति मासाः संवत्सरेण सह संविदानाः ।
यत्र यन्त्यृतवो यत्रार्तवाः स्कम्भं तं ब्रूहि कतमः स्विदेव सः॥
verses.tr: kvā'rdhamāsāḥ kva' yanti māsāḥ saṃvatsareṇa saha saṃvidānāḥ yatra yantyṛtavo yatrārtavāḥ skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svideva saḥ
verses.en: Whitherward go the half-months, and, accordant with the full year, the months in their procession? Who out of many, tell me, is that Skambha to whom go seasons and the groups of seasons?

verses.sa:
क्व१प्रेप्सन्ती युवती विरूपे अहोरात्रे द्रवतः संविदाने।
यत्र प्रेप्सन्तीरभियन्त्यापः स्कम्भं तं ब्रूहि कतमः स्विदेव सः॥
verses.tr: kva1prepsantī yuvatī virūpe ahorātre dravataḥ saṃvidāne yatra prepsantīrabhiyantyāpaḥ skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svideva saḥ
verses.en: Whitherward yearning speed the two young Damsels, accordant, Day and Night, of different colour? Who out of many, tell me, is that Skambha to whom the Waters take their way with longing?

verses.sa:
यस्मिन्त्स्तब्ध्वा प्रजापतिर्लोकान्त्सर्वाँ अधारयत्।
स्कम्भं तं ब्रूहि कतमः स्विदेव सः॥
verses.tr: yasmintstabdhvā prajāpatirlokāntsarvāṃ adhārayat skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svideva saḥ
verses.en: Who out of many, tell me, is that Skambha On whom Prajapati set up and firmly stablished all the worlds?

verses.sa:
यत् परममवमं यच्च मध्यमं प्रजापतिः ससृजे विश्वरूपम्।
कियता स्कम्भः प्र विवेश तत्र यन्न प्राविशत् कियत् तद् बभूव॥
verses.tr: yat paramamavamaṃ yacca madhyamaṃ prajāpatiḥ sasṛje viśvarūpam kiyatā skambhaḥ pra viveśa tatra yanna prāviśat kiyat tad babhūva
verses.en: That universe which Prajapati created, wearing all 'forms, the highest, midmost, lowest, How far did Skambha: penetrate within it? What portion did he leave uupeuetrated?

verses.sa:
कियता स्कम्भः प्र विवेश भूतं कियद् भविष्यदन्वाशयेऽस्य ।
एकं यदङ्गमकृणोत् सहस्रधा कियता स्कम्भः प्र विवेश तत्र॥
verses.tr: kiyatā skambhaḥ pra viveśa bhūtaṃ kiyad bhaviṣyadanvāśaye'sya ekaṃ yadaṅgamakṛṇot sahasradhā kiyatā skambhaḥ pra viveśa tatra
verses.en: How far within the past hath Skambha entered? How much of him hath reached into the future? That one part which he set in thousand, places,—how far did Skambha penetrate within it?

verses.sa:
यत्र लोकांश्च कोशांश्चापो ब्रह्म जना विदुः ।
असच्च यत्र सच्चान्त स्कम्भं तं ब्रूहि कतमः स्विदेव सः॥
verses.tr: yatra lokāṃśca kośāṃścāpo brahma janā viduḥ asacca yatra saccānta skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svideva saḥ
verses.en: Who out of many, tell me, is that Skambha in whom men recognize the Waters, Brahma, In whom they know the worlds and their enclosures, in whom are non-existence and existence?

verses.sa:
यत्र तपः पराक्रम्य व्रतं धारयत्युत्तरम्।
ऋतं च यत्र श्रद्धा चापो ब्रह्म समाहिताः स्कम्भं तं ब्रूहि कतमः स्विदेव सः॥
verses.tr: yatra tapaḥ parākramya vrataṃ dhārayatyuttaram ṛtaṃ ca yatra śraddhā cāpo brahma samāhitāḥ skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svideva saḥ
verses.en: Declare that Skambha, who is he of many, In whom, exerting every power, Fervour maintains her loftiest vow; j In whom are comprehended Law, Waters, Devotion and Belief?

verses.sa:
यस्मिन् भूमिरन्तरिक्षं द्यौर्यस्मिन्नध्याहिता ।
यत्राग्निश्चन्द्रमाः सूर्यो वातस्तिष्ठन्त्यार्पिताः स्कम्भं तं ब्रूहि कतमः स्विदेव सः॥
verses.tr: yasmin bhūmirantarikṣaṃ dyauryasminnadhyāhitā yatrāgniścandramāḥ sūryo vātastiṣṭhantyārpitāḥ skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svideva saḥ
verses.en: Who out of many, tell me, is that Skambha On whom as their foundation earth and firmament and sky are set; In whom as their appointed place rest Fire and "Moon and Sun and Wind?

verses.sa:
यस्य त्रयस्त्रिंशद् देवा अङ्गे सर्वे समाहिताः ।
स्कम्भं तं ब्रूहि कतमः स्विदेव सः॥
verses.tr: yasya trayastriṃśad devā aṅge sarve samāhitāḥ skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svideva saḥ
verses.en: Who out of many, tell me, is that Skambha, He in whose body are contained all three-and-thirty Deities?

verses.sa:
यत्र ऋषयः प्रथमजा ऋचः साम यजुर्मही।
एकर्षिर्यस्मिन्नार्पितः स्कम्भं तं ब्रूहि कतमः स्विदेव सः॥
verses.tr: yatra ṛṣayaḥ prathamajā ṛcaḥ sāma yajurmahī ekarṣiryasminnārpitaḥ skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svideva saḥ
verses.en: Who out of many, tell me, is that Skambha In whom the Sages earliest born, the Richas, Saman, Yajus, Earth, and the one highest Sage abide?

verses.sa:
यत्रामृतं च मृत्युश्च पुरुषेऽधि समाहिते ।
समुद्रो यस्य नाड्यः१ पुरुषेऽधि समाहिताः स्कम्भं तं ब्रूहि कतमः स्विदेव सः॥
verses.tr: yatrāmṛtaṃ ca mṛtyuśca puruṣe'dhi samāhite samudro yasya nāḍyaḥ1 puruṣe'dhi samāhitāḥ skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svideva saḥ
verses.en: Who out of many, tell me, is that Skambha Who comprehendeth, for mankind, both immortality and death, He who containeth for mankind the gathered waters as his veins?

verses.sa:
यस्य चतस्रः प्रदिशो नाड्य१स्तिष्ठन्ति प्रथमाः ।
यज्ञो यत्र पराक्रान्तः स्कम्भं तं ब्रूहि कतमः स्विदेव सः॥
verses.tr: yasya catasraḥ pradiśo nāḍya1stiṣṭhanti prathamāḥ yajño yatra parākrāntaḥ skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svideva saḥ
verses.en: Who out of many, tell me, is that Skambha, He whose chief arteries stand there, the sky's four regions, he in whom Sacrifice putteth forth its might?

verses.sa:
ये पुरुषे ब्रह्म विदुस्ते विदुः परमेष्ठिनम्।
यो वेद परमेष्ठिनं यश्च वेद प्रजापतिम्।
ज्येष्ठं ये ब्राह्मणं विदुस्ते स्कम्भमनुसंविदुः॥
verses.tr: ye puruṣe brahma viduste viduḥ parameṣṭhinam yo veda parameṣṭhinaṃ yaśca veda prajāpatim jyeṣṭhaṃ ye brāhmaṇaṃ viduste skambhamanusaṃviduḥ
verses.en: They who in Purusha understand Brahma know Him who is Supreme. He who knows Him who is Supreme, and he who knows the Lord of Life, l These know the loftiest Power Divine, and thence know Skambha thoroughly,

verses.sa:
यस्य शिरो वैश्वानरश्चक्षुरङ्गिरसोऽभवन्।
अङ्गानि यस्य यातवः स्कम्भं तं ब्रूहि कतमः स्विदेव सः॥
verses.tr: yasya śiro vaiśvānaraścakṣuraṅgiraso'bhavan aṅgāni yasya yātavaḥ skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svideva saḥ
verses.en: Who out of many, tell me, is that Skambha Of whom Vaisvanara became the head, the Angirases his eye, and Yajus his corporeal parts?

verses.sa:
यस्य ब्रह्म मुखमाहुर्जिह्वां मधुकशामुत।
विराजमूधो यस्याहुः स्कम्भं तं ब्रूहि कतमः स्विदेव सः॥
verses.tr: yasya brahma mukhamāhurjihvāṃ madhukaśāmuta virājamūdho yasyāhuḥ skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svideva saḥ
verses.en: Who out of many, tell me, is that Skambha. Whose mouth they say is Holy Lore, his tongue the Honey-sweetened Whip, his udder is Viraj, they say?

verses.sa:
यस्मादृचो अपातक्षन् यजुर्यस्मादपाकषन्।
सामानि यस्य लोमान्यथर्वाङ्गिरसो मुखं स्कम्भं तं ब्रूहि कतमः स्विदेव सः॥
verses.tr: yasmādṛco apātakṣan yajuryasmādapākaṣan sāmāni yasya lomānyatharvāṅgiraso mukhaṃ skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svideva saḥ
verses.en: Who out of many, tell meis that Skambha: From whom they bewed the Richas off, from whom they chipped the Yajus, he Whose hairs are Sama-verses and his mouth the Atharvangirases?

verses.sa:
असच्छाखां प्रतिष्ठन्तीं परममिव जना विदुः ।
उतो सन्मन्यन्तेऽवरे ये ते शाखामुपासते॥
verses.tr: asacchākhāṃ pratiṣṭhantīṃ paramamiva janā viduḥ uto sanmanyante'vare ye te śākhāmupāsate
verses.en: Men count as'twere a thing supreme nonentity's conspicuous branch; And lower man who serve thy branch regard it a an entity.

verses.sa:
यत्रादित्याश्च रुद्राश्च वसवश्च समाहिताः ।
भूतं च यत्र भव्यं च सर्वे लोकाः प्रतिष्ठिताः स्कम्भं तं ब्रूहि कतमः स्विदेव सः॥
verses.tr: yatrādityāśca rudrāśca vasavaśca samāhitāḥ bhūtaṃ ca yatra bhavyaṃ ca sarve lokāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svideva saḥ
verses.en: Who out of many, tell me, is that Skambha In whom Adityas dwell, in whom Rudras and Vasus are contained, 'In whom the future and the past and all the worlds are firmly set;

verses.sa:
यस्य त्रयस्त्रिंशद् देवा निधिं रक्षन्ति सर्वदा।
निधिं तमद्य को वेद यं देवा अभिरक्षथ॥
verses.tr: yasya trayastriṃśad devā nidhiṃ rakṣanti sarvadā nidhiṃ tamadya ko veda yaṃ devā abhirakṣatha
verses.en: Whose secret treasure evermore the three-and thirty. Gods protect? Who knoweth now the treasure which, O Deities ye watch and guard?

verses.sa:
यत्र देवा ब्रह्मविदो ब्रह्म ज्येष्ठमुपासते ।
यो वै तान् विद्यात् प्रत्यक्षं स ब्रह्मा वेदिता स्यात्॥
verses.tr: yatra devā brahmavido brahma jyeṣṭhamupāsate yo vai tān vidyāt pratyakṣaṃ sa brahmā veditā syāt
verses.en: Where the Gods, versed in Sacred Lore, worship the loftiest Power Divine—The priest who knows them face to face may be a sage who knows the truth.

verses.sa:
बृहन्तो नाम ते देवा येऽसतः परि जज्ञिरे।
एकं तदङ्गं स्कम्भस्यासदाहुः परो जनाः॥
verses.tr: bṛhanto nāma te devā ye'sataḥ pari jajñire ekaṃ tadaṅgaṃ skambhasyāsadāhuḥ paro janāḥ
verses.en: Great, verily, are those Gods who sprang from non-existence into life. Further, men say that that one part of Skambha is nonentity.

verses.sa:
यत्र स्कम्भः प्रजनयन् पुराणं व्यवर्तयत्।
एकं तदङ्गं स्कम्भस्य पुराणमनुसंविदुः॥
verses.tr: yatra skambhaḥ prajanayan purāṇaṃ vyavartayat ekaṃ tadaṅgaṃ skambhasya purāṇamanusaṃviduḥ
verses.en: Where Skambha generating gave the Ancient World its shape and formy They recognized that single part of Skambha-as the Ancient World,

verses.sa:
यस्य त्रयस्त्रिंशद् देवा अङ्गे गात्रा विभेजिरे।
तान् वै त्रयस्त्रिंशद् देवानेके ब्रह्मविदो विदुः॥
verses.tr: yasya trayastriṃśad devā aṅge gātrā vibhejire tān vai trayastriṃśad devāneke brahmavido viduḥ
verses.en: The three-and-thirty Gods within his body were disposed as limbs: Some, deeply versed in Holy Lore, some know those three-and-thirty Gods.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यगर्भं परममनत्युद्यं जना विदुः ।
स्कम्भस्तदग्रे प्रासिञ्चद्धिरण्यं लोके अन्तरा॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyagarbhaṃ paramamanatyudyaṃ janā viduḥ skambhastadagre prāsiñcaddhiraṇyaṃ loke antarā
verses.en: Men know Hiranyagarbha as supreme and inexpressible: In the beginning, in the midst of the world, Skambha poured that gold.

verses.sa:
स्कम्भे लोकाः स्कम्भे तपः स्कम्भेऽध्यृतमाहितम्।
स्कम्भ त्वा वेद प्रत्यक्षमिन्द्रे सर्वं समाहितम्॥
verses.tr: skambhe lokāḥ skambhe tapaḥ skambhe'dhyṛtamāhitam skambha tvā veda pratyakṣamindre sarvaṃ samāhitam
verses.en: On Skambha Fervour rests, the worlds and Holy Law repose on him. Skambha, I clearly know that all of thee on Indra is imposed,

verses.sa:
इन्द्रे लोका इन्द्रे तप इन्द्रेऽध्यृतमाहितम्।
इन्द्रं त्वा वेद प्रत्यक्षं स्कम्भे सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम्॥
verses.tr: indre lokā indre tapa indre'dhyṛtamāhitam indraṃ tvā veda pratyakṣaṃ skambhe sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam
verses.en: On Indra Fervour rests, on him the words and Holy Law recline, Indra, I clearly know that all of thee on Skambha findeth rest,

verses.sa:
नाम नाम्ना जोहवीति पुरा सूर्यात् पुरोषसः ।
यदजः प्रथमं संबभूव स ह तत् स्वराज्यमियाय यस्मान्नान्यत् परमस्ति भूतम्॥
verses.tr: nāma nāmnā johavīti purā sūryāt puroṣasaḥ yadajaḥ prathamaṃ saṃbabhūva sa ha tat svarājyamiyāya yasmānnānyat paramasti bhūtam
verses.en: Ere sun and dawn man calls and calls one Deity by the other's name, When the Unborn first sprang into existence he reached that independent sovran lordship, than which aught higher never hath arisen,

verses.sa:
यस्य भूमिः प्रमान्तरिक्षमुतोदरम्।
दिवं यश्चक्रे मूर्धानं तस्मै ज्येष्ठाय ब्रह्मणे नमः॥
verses.tr: yasya bhūmiḥ pramāntarikṣamutodaram divaṃ yaścakre mūrdhānaṃ tasmai jyeṣṭhāya brahmaṇe namaḥ
verses.en: Be revernece paid to him, that highest Brahma, whose base is Earth, his belly Air, who made the sky to be his head,

verses.sa:
यस्य सूर्यश्चक्षुश्चन्द्रमाश्च पुनर्णवः ।
अग्निं यश्चक्र आस्यं तस्मै ज्येष्ठाय ब्रह्मणे नमः॥
verses.tr: yasya sūryaścakṣuścandramāśca punarṇavaḥ agniṃ yaścakra āsyaṃ tasmai jyeṣṭhāya brahmaṇe namaḥ
verses.en: Homage to highest Brahma, him whose eye is Surya and the Moon who groweth young and new again, him who made Agni for his mouth,

verses.sa:
यस्य वातः प्राणापानौ चक्षुरङ्गिरसोऽभवन्।
दिशो यश्चक्रे प्रज्ञानीस्तस्मै ज्येष्ठाय ब्रह्मणे नमः॥
verses.tr: yasya vātaḥ prāṇāpānau cakṣuraṅgiraso'bhavan diśo yaścakre prajñānīstasmai jyeṣṭhāya brahmaṇe namaḥ
verses.en: Homage to highest Brahma, him whose two life-breathings were the Wind, The Angirases his sight; who made the regions be his means of sense,

verses.sa:
स्कम्भो दाधार द्यावापृथिवी उभे इमे स्कम्भो दाधारोर्व१न्तरिक्षम्।
स्कम्भो दाधार प्रदिशः षडुर्वीः स्कम्भ इदं विश्वं भुवनमा विवेश॥
verses.tr: skambho dādhāra dyāvāpṛthivī ubhe ime skambho dādhārorva1ntarikṣam skambho dādhāra pradiśaḥ ṣaḍurvīḥ skambha idaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanamā viveśa
verses.en: Skambha set fast these two, the earth and heaven, Skambha maintained the ample air between them. Skambha established the six spacious regions: this whole world Skambha entered and pervaded.

verses.sa:
यः श्रमात् तपसो जातो लोकान्त्सर्वान्त्समानशे।
सोमं यश्चक्रे केवलं तस्मै ज्येष्ठाय ब्रह्मणे नमः॥
verses.tr: yaḥ śramāt tapaso jāto lokāntsarvāntsamānaśe somaṃ yaścakre kevalaṃ tasmai jyeṣṭhāya brahmaṇe namaḥ
verses.en: Homage to highest Brahma, him who, sprung from Fervour and from toil, Filled all the worlds completely, who made Soma for himself alone.

verses.sa:
कथं वातो नेलयति कथं न रमते मनः ।
किमापः सत्यं प्रेप्सन्तीर्नेलयन्ति कदा चन॥
verses.tr: kathaṃ vāto nelayati kathaṃ na ramate manaḥ kimāpaḥ satyaṃ prepsantīrnelayanti kadā cana
verses.en: Why doth the Wind move ceaselessly? Why doth the spirit take no rest? Why do the Waters, seeking truth, never at any time repose?

verses.sa:
महद् यक्षं भुवनस्य मध्ये तपसि क्रान्तं सलिलस्य पृष्ठे।
तस्मिन्छ्रयन्ते य उ के च देवा वृक्षस्य स्कन्धः परित इव शाखाः॥
verses.tr: mahad yakṣaṃ bhuvanasya madhye tapasi krāntaṃ salilasya pṛṣṭhe tasminchrayante ya u ke ca devā vṛkṣasya skandhaḥ parita iva śākhāḥ
verses.en: Absorbed in Fervour, is the mighty Being, in the world's centre, on the waters' surface, To him the Deities, one and all betake them. So stands the tree-trunk with the branches round it,

verses.sa:
यस्मै हस्ताभ्यां पादाभ्यां वाचा श्रोत्रेण चक्षुषा ।
यस्मै देवाः सदा बलिं प्रयच्छन्ति विमितेऽमितं स्कम्भं तं ब्रूहि कतमः स्विदेव सः॥
verses.tr: yasmai hastābhyāṃ pādābhyāṃ vācā śrotreṇa cakṣuṣā yasmai devāḥ sadā baliṃ prayacchanti vimite'mitaṃ skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svideva saḥ
verses.en: Who out of many, tell me, is that Skambha To whom the Deities with hands, with feet, and voice, and ear, and eye Present unmeasured tribute in the measured hall of sacrifice?

verses.sa:
अप तस्य हतं तमो व्यावृत्तः स पाप्मना ।
सर्वाणि तस्मिन् ज्योतींषि यानि त्रीणि प्रजापतौ॥
verses.tr: apa tasya hataṃ tamo vyāvṛttaḥ sa pāpmanā sarvāṇi tasmin jyotīṃṣi yāni trīṇi prajāpatau
verses.en: Darkness is chased away from him: he is exempt from all distress. In him are all the lights, the three abiding in Prajapati,

verses.sa: यो वेतसं हिरण्ययं तिष्ठन्तं सलिले वेद । स वै गुह्यः प्रजापतिः॥
verses.tr: yo vetasaṃ hiraṇyayaṃ tiṣṭhantaṃ salile veda sa vai guhyaḥ prajāpatiḥ
verses.en: He verily who knows the Reed of Gold that stands amid the flood, is the mysterious Lord of Life.

verses.sa:
तन्त्रमेके युवती विरूपे अभ्याक्रामं वयतः षण्मयूखम्।
प्रान्या तन्तूंस्तिरते धत्ते अन्या नाप वृञ्जाते न गमातो अन्तम्॥
verses.tr: tantrameke yuvatī virūpe abhyākrāmaṃ vayataḥ ṣaṇmayūkham prānyā tantūṃstirate dhatte anyā nāpa vṛñjāte na gamāto antam
verses.en: Singly the two young Maids of different colours approach the six-pegged warp in turns and weave it, The one draws out the threads, the other lays them: they break them not, they reach no end of labour.

verses.sa:
तयोरहं परिनृत्यन्त्योरिव न वि जानामि यतरा परस्तात्।
पुमानेनद् वयत्युद्गृणन्ति पुमानेनद् वि जभाराधि नाके॥
verses.tr: tayorahaṃ parinṛtyantyoriva na vi jānāmi yatarā parastāt pumānenad vayatyudgṛṇanti pumānenad vi jabhārādhi nāke
verses.en: Of these two, dancing round as 'twere, I cannot distinguish whether ranks before the other, A Male inweaves this web, a Male divides it: a Male hath stretched it to the cope of heaven.

verses.sa: इमे मयूखा उप तस्तभुर्दिवं सामानि चक्रुस्तसराणि वातवे॥
verses.tr: ime mayūkhā upa tastabhurdivaṃ sāmāni cakrustasarāṇi vātave
verses.en: These pegs have buttressed up the sky. The Samans have turned them into shuttles for the weaving.

sections.label: Speculations on the Supreme Being and cosmogonical
sections.name: Book 10, hymn 8

verses.sa:
यो भूतं च भव्यं च सर्वं यश्चाधितिष्ठति ।
स्व१र्यस्य च केवलं तस्मै ज्येष्ठाय ब्रह्मणे नमः॥
verses.tr: yo bhūtaṃ ca bhavyaṃ ca sarvaṃ yaścādhitiṣṭhati sva1ryasya ca kevalaṃ tasmai jyeṣṭhāya brahmaṇe namaḥ
verses.en: Worship to loftiest Brahma, Lord of what hath been and what shall be, To him who rules the universe, and heavenly light is all his own!

verses.sa:
स्कम्भेनेमे विष्टभिते द्यौश्च भूमिश्च तिष्ठतः ।
स्कम्भ इदं सर्वमात्मन्वद् यत् प्राणन्निमिषच्च यत्॥
verses.tr: skambheneme viṣṭabhite dyauśca bhūmiśca tiṣṭhataḥ skambha idaṃ sarvamātmanvad yat prāṇannimiṣacca yat
verses.en: Upheld by Skambha's power these two, the heaven and the earth, stand fast. Skambha is all this world of life, whatever breathes or shuts an eye.

verses.sa:
तिस्रो ह प्रजा अत्यायमायन् न्य१न्या अर्कमभितोऽविशन्त ।
बृहन् ह तस्थौ रजसो विमानो हरितो हरिणीरा विवेश॥
verses.tr: tisro ha prajā atyāyamāyan nya1nyā arkamabhito'viśanta bṛhan ha tasthau rajaso vimāno harito hariṇīrā viveśa
verses.en: Three generations have gone by and vanished, and others near have entered into sunlight. There stood on high he who metes out the region: into green plants hath passed the Golden-coloured.

verses.sa:
द्वादश प्रधयश्चक्रमेकं त्रीणि नभ्यानि क उ तच्चिकेत ।
तत्राहतास्त्रीणि शतानि शङ्कवः षष्टिश्च खीला अविचाचला ये॥
verses.tr: dvādaśa pradhayaścakramekaṃ trīṇi nabhyāni ka u tacciketa tatrāhatāstrīṇi śatāni śaṅkavaḥ ṣaṣṭiśca khīlā avicācalā ye
verses.en: One is the wheel, the tires are twelve in number, the: naves are three. What man hath understood it? Three hundred spokes have thereupon been hammered, and sixty pins set firmly in their places,

verses.sa:
इदं सवितर्वि जानीहि षड् यमा एक एकजः ।
तस्मिन् हापित्वमिछन्ते य एषामेक एकजः॥
verses.tr: idaṃ savitarvi jānīhi ṣaḍ yamā eka ekajaḥ tasmin hāpitvamichante ya eṣāmeka ekajaḥ
verses.en: Discern thou this, O Savitar. Six are the twins, one singly born. They claim relationship in that among them which is born alone. li

verses.sa:
आविः सन्निहितं गुहा जरन्नाम महत् पदम्।
तत्रेदं सर्वमार्पितमेजत् प्राणत् प्रतिष्ठितम्॥
verses.tr: āviḥ sannihitaṃ guhā jarannāma mahat padam tatredaṃ sarvamārpitamejat prāṇat pratiṣṭhitam
verses.en: Though manifest, it lies concealed in the vast place they call the old: Therein is firmly stationed all the moving, breathing. universe.

verses.sa:
एकचक्रं वर्तत एकनेमि सहस्राक्षरं प्र पुरो नि पश्चा ।
अर्धेन विश्वं भुवनं जजान यदस्यार्धं क्व१तद् बभूव॥
verses.tr: ekacakraṃ vartata ekanemi sahasrākṣaraṃ pra puro ni paścā ardhena viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ jajāna yadasyārdhaṃ kva1tad babhūva
verses.en: Up, eastward, downward in the west, it rolleth, with countless elements, one-wheeled, single-fellied. With half it hath begotten all creation. Where hath the other half become unnoticed?

verses.sa:
पञ्चवाही वहत्यग्रमेषां प्रष्टयो युक्ता अनुसंवहन्ति ।
अयातमस्य ददृशे न यातं परं नेदीयोऽवरं दवीयः॥
verses.tr: pañcavāhī vahatyagrameṣāṃ praṣṭayo yuktā anusaṃvahanti ayātamasya dadṛśe na yātaṃ paraṃ nedīyo'varaṃ davīyaḥ
verses.en: In front of these the live-horsed car moves onward: side-horses, harnessed with the others draw it. No one hath seen its hither course untravelled; the height sees it more near, the depth more distant.

verses.sa:
तिर्यग्बिलश्चमस ऊर्ध्वबुध्नस्तस्मिन् यशो निहितं विश्वरूपम्।
तदासत ऋषयः सप्त साकं ये अस्य गोपा महतो बभूवुः॥
verses.tr: tiryagbilaścamasa ūrdhvabudhnastasmin yaśo nihitaṃ viśvarūpam tadāsata ṛṣayaḥ sapta sākaṃ ye asya gopā mahato babhūvuḥ
verses.en: The bowl with mouth inclined and bottom upward holds stored within it every form of glory, Thereon together sit the Seven Rishis who have become this mighty One's protectors.

verses.sa:
या पुरस्ताद् युज्यते या च पश्चाद् या विश्वतो युज्यते या च सर्वतः ।
यया यज्ञः प्राङ् तायते तां त्वा पृछामि कतमा सर्चाम्॥
verses.tr: yā purastād yujyate yā ca paścād yā viśvato yujyate yā ca sarvataḥ yayā yajñaḥ prāṅ tāyate tāṃ tvā pṛchāmi katamā sarcām
verses.en: The Verse employed at opening and conclusion, the Verse employed in each and every portion; That by which sacrifice proceeded onward, I ask thee which is that of all the Verses,

verses.sa:
यदेजति पतति यच्च तिष्ठति प्राणदप्राणन्निमिषच्च यद् भुवत्।
तद् दाधार पृथिवीं विश्वरूपं तत् संभूय भवत्येकमेव॥
verses.tr: yadejati patati yacca tiṣṭhati prāṇadaprāṇannimiṣacca yad bhuvat tad dādhāra pṛthivīṃ viśvarūpaṃ tat saṃbhūya bhavatyekameva
verses.en: That which hath power of motion, that which flies, or stands, which breathes or breathes not, which, existing, shuts the eye—Wearing all forms that entity upholds the earth, and in its close consistence still is only one.

verses.sa:
अनन्तं विततं पुरुत्रानन्तमन्तवच्चा समन्ते ।
ते नाकपालश्चरति विचिन्वन् विद्वान् भूतमुत भव्यमस्य॥
verses.tr: anantaṃ vitataṃ purutrānantamantavaccā samante te nākapālaścarati vicinvan vidvān bhūtamuta bhavyamasya
verses.en: The infinite to every side extended, the finite and the infinite around us,—These twain Heaven's Lord divides as he advances, knowing the past hereof and all the future,

verses.sa:
प्रजापतिश्चरति गर्भे अन्तरदृश्यमानो बहुधा वि जायते ।
अर्धेन विश्वं भुवनं जजान यदस्यार्धं कतमः स केतुः॥
verses.tr: prajāpatiścarati garbhe antaradṛśyamāno bahudhā vi jāyate ardhena viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ jajāna yadasyārdhaṃ katamaḥ sa ketuḥ
verses.en: Within the womb Prajapati is moving: he, though unseen, is born in sundry places, He with one half engendered all creation. What sign is there to tell us of the other?

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वं भरन्तमुदकं कुम्भेनेवोदहार्यऽम्।
पश्यन्ति सर्वे चक्षुषा न सर्वे मनसा विदुः॥
verses.tr: ūrdhvaṃ bharantamudakaṃ kumbhenevodahārya'm paśyanti sarve cakṣuṣā na sarve manasā viduḥ
verses.en: All men behold him with the eye, but with the mind they know not him Holding aloft the water as a water-bearer in her jar.

verses.sa:
दूरे पूर्णेन वसति दूर ऊनेन हीयते ।
महद् यक्षं भुवनस्य मध्ये तस्मै बलिं राष्ट्रभृतो भरन्ति॥
verses.tr: dūre pūrṇena vasati dūra ūnena hīyate mahad yakṣaṃ bhuvanasya madhye tasmai baliṃ rāṣṭrabhṛto bharanti
verses.en: With the full vase he dwells afar, is left far off what time it fails, A mighty Being in creation's centre: to him the rulers of the realms bring tribute,

verses.sa:
यतः सूर्यः उदेत्यस्तं यत्र च गच्छति ।
तदेव मन्येऽहं ज्येष्ठं तदु नात्येति किं चन॥
verses.tr: yataḥ sūryaḥ udetyastaṃ yatra ca gacchati tadeva manye'haṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ tadu nātyeti kiṃ cana
verses.en: That, whence the Sun arises, that whither he goes to take his rest, That verily I hold supreme: naught in the world surpasses it,

verses.sa:
ये अर्वाङ् मध्य उत वा पुराणं वेदं विद्वांसमभितो वदन्ति ।
आदित्यमेव ते परि वदन्ति सर्वे अग्निं द्वितीयं त्रिवृतं च हंसम्॥
verses.tr: ye arvāṅ madhya uta vā purāṇaṃ vedaṃ vidvāṃsamabhito vadanti ādityameva te pari vadanti sarve agniṃ dvitīyaṃ trivṛtaṃ ca haṃsam
verses.en: Those who in recent times, midmost, or ancient, on all sides greet the sage who knows the Veda, One and all, verily, discuss Aditya, the second Agni, and the threefold Hansa,

verses.sa:
