सहस्राह्ण्यं वियतावस्य पक्षौ हरेर्हंसस्य पततः स्वर्गम्।
स देवान्त्सर्वानुरस्युपदद्य संपश्यन् याति भुवनानि विश्वा॥
verses.tr: sahasrāhṇyaṃ viyatāvasya pakṣau harerhaṃsasya patataḥ svargam sa devāntsarvānurasyupadadya saṃpaśyan yāti bhuvanāni viśvā
verses.en: This gold-hued Haisa's wings, flying to heaven, spread o'er a thousand days continued journey. Supporting all the Gods upon his bosom, he goes his way beholding every creature,

verses.sa:
सत्येनोर्ध्वस्तपति ब्रह्मणार्वाङ् वि पश्यति ।
प्राणेन तिर्यङ् प्राणति यस्मिन् ज्येष्ठमधि श्रितम्॥
verses.tr: satyenordhvastapati brahmaṇārvāṅ vi paśyati prāṇena tiryaṅ prāṇati yasmin jyeṣṭhamadhi śritam
verses.en: By truth he blazes up aloft, by Brahma, he looks down below: He breathes obliquely with his breath, he on whom what is highest rests,

verses.sa:
यो वै ते विद्यादरणी याभ्यां निर्मथ्यते वसु ।
स विद्वान् ज्येष्ठं मन्येत स विद्याद् ब्राह्मणं महत्॥
verses.tr: yo vai te vidyādaraṇī yābhyāṃ nirmathyate vasu sa vidvān jyeṣṭhaṃ manyeta sa vidyād brāhmaṇaṃ mahat
verses.en: The sage who knows the kindling-sticks whence by attrition wealth is drawn, Will comprehend what is most high, will know the mighty Brahmana.

verses.sa:
अपादग्रे समभवत् सो अग्रे स्व१राभरत्।
चतुष्पाद् भूत्वा भोग्यः सर्वमादत्त भोजनम्॥
verses.tr: apādagre samabhavat so agre sva1rābharat catuṣpād bhūtvā bhogyaḥ sarvamādatta bhojanam
verses.en: Footless at first was he produced, footless he brought celestial light, Four-footed grown, and meet for use, he seized each thing enjoyable.

verses.sa:
भोग्यो भवदथो अन्नमदद् बहु।
यो देवमुत्तरावन्तमुपासातै सनातनम्॥
verses.tr: bhogyo bhavadatho annamadad bahu yo devamuttarāvantamupāsātai sanātanam
verses.en: Useful will he become, and then will he consume great store of food—The man who humbly worshippeth the eternal and victorious God.

verses.sa:
सनातनमेनमाहुरुताद्य स्यात् पुनर्णवः ।
अहोरात्रे प्र जायेते अन्यो अन्यस्य रूपयोः॥
verses.tr: sanātanamenamāhurutādya syāt punarṇavaḥ ahorātre pra jāyete anyo anyasya rūpayoḥ
verses.en: Him too they call eternal; he may become new again to-day. Day and Night reproduce themselves, each from the form the other wears.

verses.sa:
शतं सहस्रमयुतं न्यऽर्बुदमसंख्येयं स्वमस्मिन् निविष्टम्।
तदस्य घ्नन्त्यभिपश्यत एव तस्माद् देवो रोचत एष एतत्॥
verses.tr: śataṃ sahasramayutaṃ nya'rbudamasaṃkhyeyaṃ svamasmin niviṣṭam tadasya ghnantyabhipaśyata eva tasmād devo rocata eṣa etat
verses.en: A hundred, thousand, myriad, yea a hundred million Stores of wealth that passes count are laid in him, This wealth they kill as he looks on, and now this God shines bright therefrom,

verses.sa:
बालादेकमणीयस्कमुतैकं नेव दृश्यते ।
ततः परिष्वजीयसी देवता सा मम प्रिया॥
verses.tr: bālādekamaṇīyaskamutaikaṃ neva dṛśyate tataḥ pariṣvajīyasī devatā sā mama priyā
verses.en: One is yet finer than a hair, one is not even visible. And hence the Deity who grasps with firmer hold is dear to me. o "e: the Sun, y kill: men consume by enjoying, Shines bright the: or, is glad thereat. Mel T oe

verses.sa:
इयं कल्याण्य१जरा मर्त्यस्यामृता गृहे।
यस्मै कृता शये स यश्चकार जजार सः॥
verses.tr: iyaṃ kalyāṇya1jarā martyasyāmṛtā gṛhe yasmai kṛtā śaye sa yaścakāra jajāra saḥ
verses.en: This fair one is untouched by age, immortal in a mortal's house. He for whom she was made lies low, and he who formed her hath grown old.

verses.sa:
त्वं स्त्री त्वं पुमानसि त्वं कुमार उत वा कुमारी॥
त्वं जीर्णो दण्डेन वञ्चसि त्वं जातो भवसि विश्वतोमुखः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ strī tvaṃ pumānasi tvaṃ kumāra uta vā kumārī tvaṃ jīrṇo daṇḍena vañcasi tvaṃ jāto bhavasi viśvatomukhaḥ
verses.en: Thou art a woman, and a man; thou art a damsel and a boy. Grown old thou totterest with a staff, new-born thou lookest every way.

verses.sa:
उतैषां पितोत वा पुत्र एषामुतैषां ज्येष्ठ उत वा कनिष्ठः ।
एको ह देवो मनसि प्रविष्टः प्रथमो जातः स उ गर्भे अन्तः॥
verses.tr: utaiṣāṃ pitota vā putra eṣāmutaiṣāṃ jyeṣṭha uta vā kaniṣṭhaḥ eko ha devo manasi praviṣṭaḥ prathamo jātaḥ sa u garbhe antaḥ
verses.en: Either the sire or son of these, the eldest or the youngest child, As sole God dwelling i in the mind, first born, he still is in the womb,

verses.sa:
पूर्णात् पूर्णमुदचति पूर्णं पूर्णेन सिच्यते ।
उतो तदद्य विद्याम यतस्तत् परिषिच्यते॥
verses.tr: pūrṇāt pūrṇamudacati pūrṇaṃ pūrṇena sicyate uto tadadya vidyāma yatastat pariṣicyate
verses.en: Forth from the full he lifts the full, the full he sprinkles with the full, Now also may we know the source from which that stream is sprinkled round,

verses.sa:
एषा सनत्नी सनमेव जातैषा पुराणी परि सर्वं बभूव ।
मही देव्यु१षसो विभाती सैकेनैकेन मिषता वि चष्टे॥
verses.tr: eṣā sanatnī sanameva jātaiṣā purāṇī pari sarvaṃ babhūva mahī devyu1ṣaso vibhātī saikenaikena miṣatā vi caṣṭe
verses.en: Brought forth in olden time, the everlasting, high over all that is was she, the Ancient, The mighty Goddess of the Morn, refulgent with one eye, looketh round with one that winketh.

verses.sa:
अविर्वै नाम देवतर्तेनास्ते परीवृता ।
तस्या रूपेणेमे वृक्षा हरिता हरितस्रजः॥
verses.tr: avirvai nāma devatartenāste parīvṛtā tasyā rūpeṇeme vṛkṣā haritā haritasrajaḥ
verses.en: Known by the name of Guardian Grace the Deity sits girt by Right, The trees have taken from her hue, green-garlanded, their robe of green.

verses.sa:
अन्ति सन्तं न जहात्यन्ति सन्तं न पश्यति ।
देवस्य पश्य काव्यं न ममार न जीर्यति॥
verses.tr: anti santaṃ na jahātyanti santaṃ na paśyati devasya paśya kāvyaṃ na mamāra na jīryati
verses.en: When he is near she leaves him not, she sees him not though he is near, Behold the wisdom of the God; he hath not died, he grows not old.

verses.sa:
अपूर्वेणेषिता वाचस्ता वदन्ति यथायथम्।
वदन्तीर्यत्र गच्छन्ति तदाहुर्ब्राह्मणं महत्॥
verses.tr: apūrveṇeṣitā vācastā vadanti yathāyatham vadantīryatra gacchanti tadāhurbrāhmaṇaṃ mahat
verses.en: Voices that never were before emitted speak as fitteth them, Whither they go and speak, they say there is the mighty Brahman.

verses.sa:
यत्र देवाश्च मनुष्याऽश्चारा नाभाविव श्रिताः ।
अपां त्वा पुष्पं पृच्छामि यत्र तन्मायया हितम्॥
verses.tr: yatra devāśca manuṣyā'ścārā nābhāviva śritāḥ apāṃ tvā puṣpaṃ pṛcchāmi yatra tanmāyayā hitam
verses.en: I ask thee where the waters' flower by wondrous magic art was placed, Thereon the Gods and men are set as spokes are fastened in the nave,

verses.sa:
ये भिर्वात इषितः प्रवाति ये ददन्ते पञ्च दिशः सध्रीचीः ।
य आहुतिमत्यमन्यन्त देवा अपां नेतारः कतमे त आसन्॥
verses.tr: ye bhirvāta iṣitaḥ pravāti ye dadante pañca diśaḥ sadhrīcīḥ ya āhutimatyamanyanta devā apāṃ netāraḥ katame ta āsan
verses.en: Who gave command unto the wind that blowet? Who ranged the five united heavenly regions? Who were the Gods who cared not for oblations? Which of them brought the sacrificial waters?

verses.sa:
इमामेषां पृथिवीं वस्त एकोऽन्तरिक्षं पर्येको बभूव ।
दिवमेषां ददते यो विधर्ता विश्वा आशाः प्रति रक्षन्त्येके॥
verses.tr: imāmeṣāṃ pṛthivīṃ vasta eko'ntarikṣaṃ paryeko babhūva divameṣāṃ dadate yo vidhartā viśvā āśāḥ prati rakṣantyeke
verses.en: One God inhabiteth the earth we live on; another hath encompassed air's mid-region. One, the Supporter, takes the heaven and bears it: some keeping watch guard all the quarters safely.

verses.sa:
यो विद्यात् सूत्रं विततं यस्मिन्नोताः प्रजा इमाः ।
सूत्रं सूत्रस्य यो विद्याद् स विद्याद् ब्राह्मणं महत्॥
verses.tr: yo vidyāt sūtraṃ vitataṃ yasminnotāḥ prajā imāḥ sūtraṃ sūtrasya yo vidyād sa vidyād brāhmaṇaṃ mahat
verses.en: The man who knows the drawn-out string on which these creatures all are strung, The man who knows the thread's thread, he may know the mighty Brahmana.

verses.sa:
वेदाहं सूत्रं विततं यस्मिन्नोताः प्रजा इमाः ।
सूत्रं सूत्रस्याहं वेदाथो यद् ब्राह्मणं महत्॥
verses.tr: vedāhaṃ sūtraṃ vitataṃ yasminnotāḥ prajā imāḥ sūtraṃ sūtrasyāhaṃ vedātho yad brāhmaṇaṃ mahat
verses.en: I know the drawn-out string, the thread whereon these creatures all are strung, I know the thread's thread also, thus I know the mighty Brahmana,

verses.sa:
यदन्तरा द्यावापृथिवी अग्निरैत् प्रदहन् विश्वदाव्यः ।
यत्रातिष्ठन्नेकपत्नीः परस्तात् क्वेऽवासीन्मातरिश्वा तदानीम्॥
verses.tr: yadantarā dyāvāpṛthivī agnirait pradahan viśvadāvyaḥ yatrātiṣṭhannekapatnīḥ parastāt kve'vāsīnmātariśvā tadānīm
verses.en: When Agni passed between the earth and heaven, devouring with his flame, the all-consumer Where dwelt afar the spouse of one husband, where at that moment, where was Matarisvan?

verses.sa:
अप्स्वाऽसीन्मातरिश्वा प्रविष्टः प्रविष्टा देवाः सलिलान्यासन्॥
बृहन् ह तस्थौ रजसो विमानः पवमानो हरित आ विवेश॥
verses.tr: apsvā'sīnmātariśvā praviṣṭaḥ praviṣṭā devāḥ salilānyāsan bṛhan ha tasthau rajaso vimānaḥ pavamāno harita ā viveśa
verses.en: Into the floods had Matarisvan entered, the deities had past into the waters. There stood the mighty measurer of the region: into the verdant plants went Pavamana.

verses.sa:
उत्तरेणेव गायत्रीममृतेऽधि वि चक्रमे ।
साम्ना ये साम संविदुरजस्तद् ददृशे क्वऽ॥
verses.tr: uttareṇeva gāyatrīmamṛte'dhi vi cakrame sāmnā ye sāma saṃvidurajastad dadṛśe kva'
verses.en: Over the Gayatri, above the immortal world he strode away, Those who by Song discovered Song where did the Unborn see that thing?

verses.sa:
निवेशनः संगमनो वसूनां देव इव सविता सत्यधर्मा ।
इन्द्रो न तस्थौ समरे धनानाम्॥
verses.tr: niveśanaḥ saṃgamano vasūnāṃ deva iva savitā satyadharmā indro na tasthau samare dhanānām
verses.en: Luller to rest, and gatherer-up of treasures, Savitar like a God whose laws are constant, hath stood like Indra in the war for riches,

verses.sa:
पुण्डरीकं नवद्वारं त्रिभिर्गुणेभिरावृतम्।
तस्मिन् यद् यक्षमात्मन्वत् तद् वै ब्रह्मविदो विदुः॥
verses.tr: puṇḍarīkaṃ navadvāraṃ tribhirguṇebhirāvṛtam tasmin yad yakṣamātmanvat tad vai brahmavido viduḥ
verses.en: Men versed in sacred knowledge know that living Being that abides. In the nine-portalled Lotus Flower, enclosed with triple bands and bonds.

verses.sa:
अकामो धीरो अमृतः स्वयंभू रसेन तृप्तो न कुतश्चनोनः ।
तमेव विद्वान् न बिभाय मृत्योरात्मानं धीरमजरं युवानम्॥
verses.tr: akāmo dhīro amṛtaḥ svayaṃbhū rasena tṛpto na kutaścanonaḥ tameva vidvān na bibhāya mṛtyorātmānaṃ dhīramajaraṃ yuvānam
verses.en: Desireless, firm, immortal, self-existent, contented with the essence, lacking nothing, Free from the fear of Death is he who knoweth that Soul courageous, youthful, undecaying.

verses.sa:
अघायतामपि नह्या मुखानि सपत्नेषु वज्रमर्पयैतम्।
इन्द्रेण दत्ता प्रथमा शतौदना भ्रातृव्यघ्नी यजमानस्य गातुः॥
verses.tr: aghāyatāmapi nahyā mukhāni sapatneṣu vajramarpayaitam indreṇa dattā prathamā śataudanā bhrātṛvyaghnī yajamānasya gātuḥ
verses.en: Binding the mouths of those who threaten mischief, against my rivals cast this bolt of thunder. Indra first gave the Hundredfold Oblation, welfare of him who worships, foe-destroying.

verses.sa:
वेदिष्टे चर्म भवतु बर्हिर्लोमानि यानि ते ।
एषा त्वा रशनाग्रभीद् ग्रावा त्वैषोऽधि नृत्यतु॥
verses.tr: vediṣṭe carma bhavatu barhirlomāni yāni te eṣā tvā raśanāgrabhīd grāvā tvaiṣo'dhi nṛtyatu
verses.en: Thy skin shall be the Altar; let thine hair become the Sacred Grass, This cord hath held thee firmly: let this pressing-stone dance round on thee,

verses.sa:
बालास्ते प्रोक्षणीः सन्तु जीह्वा सं मार्ष्ट्वघ्न्ये ।
शुद्धा त्वं यज्ञिया भूत्वा दिवं प्रेहि शतौदने॥
verses.tr: bālāste prokṣaṇīḥ santu jīhvā saṃ mārṣṭvaghnye śuddhā tvaṃ yajñiyā bhūtvā divaṃ prehi śataudane
verses.en: The holy water be thy hair: let thy tongue make thee clean, O Cow. Go, Hundredfold Oblation, made bright and adorable, to heaven.

verses.sa:
यः शतौदनां पचति कामप्रेण स कल्पते ।
प्रीता ह्यऽस्यर्त्विजः सर्वे यन्ति यथायथम्॥
verses.tr: yaḥ śataudanāṃ pacati kāmapreṇa sa kalpate prītā hya'syartvijaḥ sarve yanti yathāyatham
verses.en: He who prepares the Hundredfold Oblation gain each wish thereby: For all his ministering priests, contented, move a fitteth them,

verses.sa:
स स्वर्गमा रोहति यत्रादस्त्रिदिवं दिवः ।
अपूपनाभिं कृत्वा यो ददाति शतौदनाम्॥
verses.tr: sa svargamā rohati yatrādastridivaṃ divaḥ apūpanābhiṃ kṛtvā yo dadāti śataudanām
verses.en: He rises up to heaven, ascends to yonder third celestial height, Whoever gives the Hundredfold Oblation with the central cake.

verses.sa:
स तांल्लोकान्त्समाप्नोति ये दिव्या ये च पार्थिवाः ।
हिरण्यज्योतिषं कृत्वा यो ददाति शतौदनाम्॥
verses.tr: sa tāṃllokāntsamāpnoti ye divyā ye ca pārthivāḥ hiraṇyajyotiṣaṃ kṛtvā yo dadāti śataudanām
verses.en: That man completely wins those worlds, both of the heavens and of the earth, Whoever pays the Hundredfold. Oblation with its golden light,

verses.sa:
ये ते देवि शमितारः पक्तारो ये च ते जनाः ।
ते त्वा सर्वे गोप्स्यन्ति मैभ्यो भैषीः शतौदने॥
verses.tr: ye te devi śamitāraḥ paktāro ye ca te janāḥ te tvā sarve gopsyanti maibhyo bhaiṣīḥ śataudane
verses.en: Thine Immolators, Goddess! and the men who dress thee for the feast, all these will guard thee, Hundredfold Oblation! Have no fear of them.

verses.sa:
वसवस्त्वा दक्षिणत उत्तरान्मरुतस्त्वा ।
आदित्याः पश्चाद् गोप्स्यन्ति साग्निष्टोममति द्रव॥
verses.tr: vasavastvā dakṣiṇata uttarānmarutastvā ādityāḥ paścād gopsyanti sāgniṣṭomamati drava
verses.en: The Vasus from the South will be thy guards, the Maruts from the North, Adityas from the West: overtake and pass the Agnishtoma, thou!

verses.sa:
देवाः पितरो मनुष्याऽ गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्च ये।
ते त्वा सर्वे गोप्स्यन्ति सातिरात्रमति द्रव॥
verses.tr: devāḥ pitaro manuṣyā' gandharvāpsarasaśca ye te tvā sarve gopsyanti sātirātramati drava
verses.en: The Gods, the Fathers, mortal men, Gandharvas, and Apsarases, All these will be thy guards: overtake and pass the Atiratra, thou!

verses.sa:
अन्तरिक्षं दिवं भूमिमादित्यान् मरुतो दिशः ।
लोकान्त्स सर्वानाप्नोति यो ददाति शतौदनाम्॥
verses.tr: antarikṣaṃ divaṃ bhūmimādityān maruto diśaḥ lokāntsa sarvānāpnoti yo dadāti śataudanām
verses.en: The man who pays the Hundredfold Oblation winneth all the worlds, Air, heaven, and earth, Adityas, and Maruts, and regions of the sky.

verses.sa:
घृतं प्रोक्षन्ती सुभगा देवी देवान् गमिष्यति ।
पक्तारमघ्न्ये मा हिंसीर्दिवं प्रेहि शतौदने॥
verses.tr: ghṛtaṃ prokṣantī subhagā devī devān gamiṣyati paktāramaghnye mā hiṃsīrdivaṃ prehi śataudane
verses.en: -Sprinkling down fatness, to the Gods will the beneficent Goddess go. Harm not thy dresser, Cow! To heaven, O Hundredfold Oblation, speed!

verses.sa:
ये देवा दिविषदो अन्तरिक्षसदश्च ये ये चेमे भूम्यामधि ।
तेभ्यस्त्वं धुक्ष्व सर्वदा क्षीरं सर्पिरथो मधु॥
verses.tr: ye devā diviṣado antarikṣasadaśca ye ye ceme bhūmyāmadhi tebhyastvaṃ dhukṣva sarvadā kṣīraṃ sarpiratho madhu
verses.en: From all the Gods enthroned in heaven, in air, from those who dwell on earth, Draw forth for evermore a stream of milk, of butter, and of mead,

verses.sa:
यत् ते शिरो यत् ते मुखं यौ कर्णौ ये च ते हनू ।
आमिक्षां दुह्रतां दात्रे क्षीरं सर्पिरथो मधु॥
verses.tr: yat te śiro yat te mukhaṃ yau karṇau ye ca te hanū āmikṣāṃ duhratāṃ dātre kṣīraṃ sarpiratho madhu
verses.en: Let thy head, let thy mouth, let both thine ears, and those two jaws of thine, Pour for the giver mingled curd, and flowing butter, milk, and mead,

verses.sa:
यौ त ओष्ठौ ये नासिके ये शृङ्गे ये च तेऽक्षिणी ।
आमिक्षां दुह्रतां दात्रे क्षीरं सर्पिरथो मधु॥
verses.tr: yau ta oṣṭhau ye nāsike ye śṛṅge ye ca te'kṣiṇī āmikṣāṃ duhratāṃ dātre kṣīraṃ sarpiratho madhu
verses.en: Let both thy lips, thy nostrils, both thy horns, and those two eyes of thins Pour for the giver, etc.

verses.sa:
यत् ते क्लोमा यद्धृदयं पुरीतत् सहकण्ठिका ।
आमिक्षां दुह्रतां दात्रे क्षीरं सर्पिरथो मधु॥
verses.tr: yat te klomā yaddhṛdayaṃ purītat sahakaṇṭhikā āmikṣāṃ duhratāṃ dātre kṣīraṃ sarpiratho madhu
verses.en: Let heart and pericardium, let thy lungs with all the bronchial tubes, etc.

verses.sa:
यत् ते यकृद् ये मतस्ने यदान्त्रं याश्च ते गुदाः ।
आमिक्षां दुह्रतां दात्रे क्षीरं सर्पिरथो मधु॥
verses.tr: yat te yakṛd ye matasne yadāntraṃ yāśca te gudāḥ āmikṣāṃ duhratāṃ dātre kṣīraṃ sarpiratho madhu
verses.en: Let liver, and let kidneys, let thine entrails, and the parte within, etc.

verses.sa:
यस्ते प्लाशिर्यो वनिष्ठुर्यौ कुक्षी यच्च चर्म ते ।
आमिक्षां दुह्रतां दात्रे क्षीरं सर्पिरथो मधु॥
verses.tr: yaste plāśiryo vaniṣṭhuryau kukṣī yacca carma te āmikṣāṃ duhratāṃ dātre kṣīraṃ sarpiratho madhu
verses.en: Let rectum and omentum, let thy belly's hollows, and thy skin, etc.

verses.sa:
यत् ते मज्जा यदस्थि यन्मांसं यच्च लोहितम्।
आमिक्षां दुह्रतां दात्रे क्षीरं सर्पिरथो मधु॥
verses.tr: yat te majjā yadasthi yanmāṃsaṃ yacca lohitam āmikṣāṃ duhratāṃ dātre kṣīraṃ sarpiratho madhu
verses.en: Let all thy marrow, every bone, let all thy flesh, and all thy blood, etc.

verses.sa:
यौ ते बाहू ये दोषणी यावंसौ या च ते ककुत्।
आमिक्षां दुह्रतां दात्रे क्षीरं सर्पिरथो मधु॥
verses.tr: yau te bāhū ye doṣaṇī yāvaṃsau yā ca te kakut āmikṣāṃ duhratāṃ dātre kṣīraṃ sarpiratho madhu
verses.en: Let both thy shoulders and thy hump, thy forelegs, and their lower parts, etc,

verses.sa:
यास्ते ग्रीवा ये स्कन्धा याः पृष्टीर्याश्च पर्शवः ।
आमिक्षां दुह्रतां दात्रे क्षीरं सर्पिरथो मधु॥
verses.tr: yāste grīvā ye skandhā yāḥ pṛṣṭīryāśca parśavaḥ āmikṣāṃ duhratāṃ dātre kṣīraṃ sarpiratho madhu
verses.en: Let neck and nape and shoulder-joints, thy ribs and inter-costal parts, etc.

verses.sa:
यौ त उरू अष्ठीवन्तौ ये श्रोणी या च ते भसत्।
आमिक्षां दुह्रतां दात्रे क्षीरं सर्पिरथो मधु॥
verses.tr: yau ta urū aṣṭhīvantau ye śroṇī yā ca te bhasat āmikṣāṃ duhratāṃ dātre kṣīraṃ sarpiratho madhu
verses.en: So let thy thighs and thy knee-bones, thy. hinder quarters, and thy hips, etc,

verses.sa:
यत् ते पुच्छं ये ते बाला यदूधो ये च ते स्तनाः ।
आमिक्षां दुह्रतां दात्रे क्षीरं सर्पिरथो मधु॥
verses.tr: yat te pucchaṃ ye te bālā yadūdho ye ca te stanāḥ āmikṣāṃ duhratāṃ dātre kṣīraṃ sarpiratho madhu
verses.en: So let thy tail and all the hairs thereof, thine udder, and thy tents, etc.

verses.sa:
यास्ते जङ्घाः याः कुष्ठिका ऋच्छरा ये च ते शफाः ।
आमिक्षां दुह्रतां दात्रे क्षीरं सर्पिरथो मधु॥
verses.tr: yāste jaṅghāḥ yāḥ kuṣṭhikā ṛccharā ye ca te śaphāḥ āmikṣāṃ duhratāṃ dātre kṣīraṃ sarpiratho madhu
verses.en: Let all thy legs, the refuse of thy feet, thy heel-ropes, and thy hooves, Pour for the giver mingled curd, and flowing butter, milk, and mead,

verses.sa:
यत् ते चर्म शतौदने यानि लोमान्यघ्न्ये ।
आमिक्षां दुह्रतां दात्रे क्षीरं सर्पिरथो मधु॥
verses.tr: yat te carma śataudane yāni lomānyaghnye āmikṣāṃ duhratāṃ dātre kṣīraṃ sarpiratho madhu
verses.en: Let all thy skin, Sataudnna I let every hair thou hast, Cow, Pour for the giver mingled curd, and flowing butter, milk, and mead,

verses.sa:
क्रोडौ ते स्तां पुरोडाशावाज्येनाभिघारितौ ।
तौ पक्षौ देवि कृत्वा सा पक्तारं दिवं वह॥
verses.tr: kroḍau te stāṃ puroḍāśāvājyenābhighāritau tau pakṣau devi kṛtvā sā paktāraṃ divaṃ vaha
verses.en: Sprinkled with molten butter, let the two meal-cakes be sport for thee. Make them thy wings, O Goddess, and bear him who dresses thee to heaven.

verses.sa:
उलूखले मुसले यश्च चर्मणि यो वा शूर्पे तण्डुलः कणः ।
यं वा वातो मातरिश्वा पवमानो ममाथाग्निष्टद्धोता सुहुतं कृणोतु॥
verses.tr: ulūkhale musale yaśca carmaṇi yo vā śūrpe taṇḍulaḥ kaṇaḥ yaṃ vā vāto mātariśvā pavamāno mamāthāgniṣṭaddhotā suhutaṃ kṛṇotu
verses.en: Each grain of rice in mortar or on pestle, all on the skin or in the winnowing-basket, Whatever purifying Matarisvan, the Wind, hath sifted, let the Hotar Agni make of it an acceptable oblation.

verses.sa:
अपो देवी र्मधुमतीर्घृतश्चुतो ब्रह्मणां हस्तेषु प्रपृथक् सादयामि ।
यत् काम इदमभिषिञ्चामि वोऽहं तन्मे सर्वं सं पद्यतां वयं स्याम पतयो रयीणाम्॥
verses.tr: apo devī rmadhumatīrghṛtaścuto brahmaṇāṃ hasteṣu prapṛthak sādayāmi yat kāma idamabhiṣiñcāmi vo'haṃ tanme sarvaṃ saṃ padyatāṃ vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām
verses.en: In the priest's hands I lay, in separate order, the sweet celestial Waters, dropping fatness. As here I sprinkle them may all my wishes de granted unto me in perfect fulness, May we have ample wealth in our possession,

sections.label: A glorification of the sacred Cow as representing the radiant heavens
sections.name: Book 10, hymn 10

verses.sa:
नमस्ते जायमानायै जाताया उत ते नमः ।
बालेभ्यः शफेभ्यो रूपायाघ्न्ये ते नमः॥
verses.tr: namaste jāyamānāyai jātāyā uta te namaḥ bālebhyaḥ śaphebhyo rūpāyāghnye te namaḥ
verses.en: Worship to thee springing to life, and worship unto thee when born! Worship, O Cow, to thy tail-hair, and to thy hooves, and to thy form!

verses.sa:
यो विद्यात् सप्त प्रवतः सप्त विद्यात् परावतः ।
शिरो यज्ञस्य यो विद्यात् स वशां प्रति गृह्णीयात्॥
verses.tr: yo vidyāt sapta pravataḥ sapta vidyāt parāvataḥ śiro yajñasya yo vidyāt sa vaśāṃ prati gṛhṇīyāt
verses.en: The man who knows the Seven Floods, who knows-the seven distances, Who knows the head of sacrifice, he may receive the holy Cow.

verses.sa:
वेदाहं सप्त प्रवतः सप्त वेद परावतः ।
शिरो यज्ञस्याहं वेद सोमं चास्यां विचक्षणम्॥
verses.tr: vedāhaṃ sapta pravataḥ sapta veda parāvataḥ śiro yajñasyāhaṃ veda somaṃ cāsyāṃ vicakṣaṇam
verses.en: I know the Seven Water-floods, I know the seven distances, I know the head of sacrifice, and Soma shining bright in her,

verses.sa:
यया द्यौर्यया पृथिवी ययापो गुपिता इमाः।
वशां सहस्रधारां ब्रह्मणाच्छावदामसि॥
verses.tr: yayā dyauryayā pṛthivī yayāpo gupitā imāḥ vaśāṃ sahasradhārāṃ brahmaṇācchāvadāmasi
verses.en: Hitherward we invite with prayer the Cow who pours a thousand streams, By whom the heaven, by whom the earth, by whom these waters are preserved.

verses.sa:
शतं कंसाः शतं दोग्धारः शतं गोप्तारो अधि पृष्ठे अस्याः ।
ये देवास्तस्यां प्राणन्ति ते वशां विदुरेकधा॥
verses.tr: śataṃ kaṃsāḥ śataṃ dogdhāraḥ śataṃ goptāro adhi pṛṣṭhe asyāḥ ye devāstasyāṃ prāṇanti te vaśāṃ vidurekadhā
verses.en: Upon her back there are a hundred keepers, a hundred metal bowls, a hundred milkers. The Deities who breathe in her all separately know the Cow,

verses.sa:
यज्ञपदीराक्षीरा स्वधाप्राणा महीलुका ।
वशा पर्जन्यपत्नी देवाँ अप्येति ब्रह्मणा॥
verses.tr: yajñapadīrākṣīrā svadhāprāṇā mahīlukā vaśā parjanyapatnī devāṃ apyeti brahmaṇā
verses.en: Her foot is sacrifice, her milk libation, Svadha her breath, Mahiluka the mighty: To the God goes with prayer the Cow who hath Parjanya for her lord,

verses.sa:
अनु त्वाग्निः प्राविशदनु सोमो वशे त्वा ।
ऊधस्ते भद्रे पर्जन्यो विद्युतस्ते स्तना वशे॥
verses.tr: anu tvāgniḥ prāviśadanu somo vaśe tvā ūdhaste bhadre parjanyo vidyutaste stanā vaśe
verses.en: Agni hath entered into thee; Soma, O Cow, hath entered thee, Thine udder is Parjanya, O blest Cow; the lightnings are thy teats.

verses.sa:
अपस्त्वं धुक्षे प्रथमा उर्वरा अपरा वशे ।
तृतीयं राष्ट्रं धुक्षेऽन्नं क्षीरं वशे त्वम्॥
verses.tr: apastvaṃ dhukṣe prathamā urvarā aparā vaśe tṛtīyaṃ rāṣṭraṃ dhukṣe'nnaṃ kṣīraṃ vaśe tvam
verses.en: Thou pourest out the Waters first, and corn-lands afterward, O Cow, Thirdly thou -pourest princely sway. O Cow, thou. pourest food and milk.

verses.sa:
यदादित्यैर्हूयमानोपातिष्ठ ऋतवरि ।
इन्द्रः सहस्रं पात्रान्त्सोमं त्वापाययद् वशे॥
verses.tr: yadādityairhūyamānopātiṣṭha ṛtavari indraḥ sahasraṃ pātrāntsomaṃ tvāpāyayad vaśe
verses.en: When, Holy One, thou earnest nigh invited by the A dityas call, Indra gave thee to drink, O cow, a thousand bowls of Soma juice.

verses.sa:
यदनूचीन्द्रमैरात् त्व ऋषभोऽह्वयत्।
तस्मात् ते वृत्रहा पयः क्षीरं क्रुद्धोऽहरद् वशे॥
verses.tr: yadanūcīndramairāt tva ṛṣabho'hvayat tasmāt te vṛtrahā payaḥ kṣīraṃ kruddho'harad vaśe
verses.en: The Bull, what time thou followedst the way of Indra, summoned thee; Thence the Fiend-slayer, angered, took thy water and thy milk away.

verses.sa:
यत् ते क्रुद्धो धनपतिरा क्षीरमहरद् वशे ।
इदं तदद्य नाकस्त्रिषु पात्रेषु रक्षति॥
verses.tr: yat te kruddho dhanapatirā kṣīramaharad vaśe idaṃ tadadya nākastriṣu pātreṣu rakṣati
verses.en: O Cow, the milk which in his wrath the Lord of Riches took from thee, That same the vault of heaven now preserveth in three reservoirs.

verses.sa:
त्रिषु पात्रेषु तं सोममा देव्यऽहरद् वशा।
अथर्वा यत्र दीक्षितो बर्हिष्यास्त हिरण्यये॥
verses.tr: triṣu pātreṣu taṃ somamā devya'harad vaśā atharvā yatra dīkṣito barhiṣyāsta hiraṇyaye
verses.en: The Cow Celestial received that Soma in three vessels, where Atharvan, consecrated, sate upon the Sacred Grass of gold.

verses.sa:
सं हि सोमेनागत समु सर्वेण पद्वता ।
वशा समुद्रमध्यष्ठाद् गन्धर्वैः कलिभिः सह॥
verses.tr: saṃ hi somenāgata samu sarveṇa padvatā vaśā samudramadhyaṣṭhād gandharvaiḥ kalibhiḥ saha
verses.en: Come hither with the Soma, come with every footed thing; the Cow With Kills and Gandharvas by her side hath stepped upon the sea. l

verses.sa:
सं हि वातेनागत समु सर्वैः पतत्रिभिः ।
वशा समुद्रे प्रानृत्यदृचः सामानि बिभ्रती॥
verses.tr: saṃ hi vātenāgata samu sarvaiḥ patatribhiḥ vaśā samudre prānṛtyadṛcaḥ sāmāni bibhratī
verses.en: Come hither with the Wind, yea, come with every creature borne on wings. Laden with holy verse and song the Cow hath leapt into the sea,

verses.sa:
सं हि सूर्येणागत समु सर्वेण चक्षुषा ।
वशा समुद्रमत्यख्यद् भद्रा ज्योतींषि बिभ्रती॥
verses.tr: saṃ hi sūryeṇāgata samu sarveṇa cakṣuṣā vaśā samudramatyakhyad bhadrā jyotīṃṣi bibhratī
verses.en: Come with the Sun, come hitherward with every creature that hath eyes, Bearing auspicious lights with her the Cow hath looked across the sea,

verses.sa:
अभीवृता हिरण्येन यदतिष्ठ ऋतावरि ।
अश्वः समुद्रो भूत्वाध्यस्कन्दद् वशे त्वा॥
verses.tr: abhīvṛtā hiraṇyena yadatiṣṭha ṛtāvari aśvaḥ samudro bhūtvādhyaskandad vaśe tvā
verses.en: When, covered round about with gold, thou-stoodest there, O Holy One, The ocean turned into a horse and mounted on thy back, O Cow.

verses.sa:
तद् भद्राः समगच्छन्त वशा देष्ट्र्यथो स्वधा।
अथर्वा यत्र दीक्षितो बर्हिष्यास्त हिरण्यये॥
verses.tr: tad bhadrāḥ samagacchanta vaśā deṣṭryatho svadhā atharvā yatra dīkṣito barhiṣyāsta hiraṇyaye
verses.en: Then came and met the Blessed Ones, Deshtri, the, Cow, and Svadha, where Atharvan, consecrated, sate upon the Sacred Grass of gold.

verses.sa:
वशा माता राजन्यऽस्य वशा माता स्वधे तव ।
वशाया यज्ञ आयुधं ततश्चित्तमजायत॥
verses.tr: vaśā mātā rājanya'sya vaśā mātā svadhe tava vaśāyā yajña āyudhaṃ tataścittamajāyata
verses.en: The Kshatriya's mother is the Cow, thy mother, Svadha! is the Cow, Sacrifice is the weapon oft he Cow: the thought arose from her.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वो बिन्दुरुदचरद् ब्रह्मणः ककुदादधि ।
ततस्त्वं जज्ञिषे वशे ततो होताजायत॥
verses.tr: ūrdhvo bindurudacarad brahmaṇaḥ kakudādadhi tatastvaṃ jajñiṣe vaśe tato hotājāyata
verses.en: From Brahma's summit there went forth a drop that mounted up on high: From that wast thou produced, O Cow, from that the Hotar sprang to life.

verses.sa:
आस्नस्ते गाथा अभवन्नुष्णिहाभ्यो बलं वशे ।
पाजस्याऽज्जज्ञे यज्ञ स्तनेभ्यो रश्मयस्तव॥
verses.tr: āsnaste gāthā abhavannuṣṇihābhyo balaṃ vaśe pājasyā'jjajñe yajña stanebhyo raśmayastava
verses.en: Forth from thy mouth the Gathas came, from thy neck's nape sprang strength, O Cow. Sacrifice from thy flanks was born, and rays of sunlight from thy teats,

verses.sa:
ईर्माभ्यामयनं जातं सक्थिभ्यां च वशे तव ।
आन्त्रेभ्यो जज्ञिरे अत्रा उदरादधि वीरुधः॥
verses.tr: īrmābhyāmayanaṃ jātaṃ sakthibhyāṃ ca vaśe tava āntrebhyo jajñire atrā udarādadhi vīrudhaḥ
verses.en: From thy fore-qunrters and thy thighs motion was generated, Cow! Food from thine entrails was produced, and from thy belly came the plants,

verses.sa:
यदुदरं वरुणस्यानुप्राविशथा वशे ।
ततस्त्वा ब्रह्मोदह्वयत् स हि नेत्रमवेत् तव॥
verses.tr: yadudaraṃ varuṇasyānuprāviśathā vaśe tatastvā brahmodahvayat sa hi netramavet tava
verses.en: When into Varuna's belly thou hadst found a pace: age for thyself, The Brahman called thee thence, for he knew how to guide and lead thee forth,

verses.sa:
सर्वे गर्भादवेपन्त जायमानादसूस्वः ।
ससूव हि तामाहुवशेति ब्रह्मभिः क्लृप्तः स ह्यऽस्या बन्धुः॥
verses.tr: sarve garbhādavepanta jāyamānādasūsvaḥ sasūva hi tāmāhuvaśeti brahmabhiḥ klṛptaḥ sa hya'syā bandhuḥ
verses.en: All trembled at the babe that came from him who brings not to the birth, He hath produced her—thus they cried—He is a cow, and, formed by spells, he hath become akin to her.

verses.sa:
युध एकः सं सृजति यो अस्या एक इद् वशी।
तरांसि यज्ञा अभवन् तरसां चक्षुरभवद् वशा॥
verses.tr: yudha ekaḥ saṃ sṛjati yo asyā eka id vaśī tarāṃsi yajñā abhavan tarasāṃ cakṣurabhavad vaśā
verses.en: He only joineth battle, yea, he who al6ne controlleth her. Now sacrifices have become victories, and the Cow their eye.

verses.sa:
वशा यज्ञं प्रत्यगृह्णाद् वशा सूर्यमधारयत्।
वशायामन्तरविशदोदनो ब्रह्मणा सह॥
verses.tr: vaśā yajñaṃ pratyagṛhṇād vaśā sūryamadhārayat vaśāyāmantaraviśadodano brahmaṇā saha
verses.en: The Cow hath welcomed sacrifice: the Cow hath held the Sun in place. Together with the prayer the mess of rice hath passed into the Cow,

verses.sa:
वशामेवामृतमाहुर्वशां मृत्युमुपासते ।
वशेदं सर्वमभवद् देवा मनुष्या३ असुराः पितर ऋषयः॥
verses.tr: vaśāmevāmṛtamāhurvaśāṃ mṛtyumupāsate vaśedaṃ sarvamabhavad devā manuṣyā3 asurāḥ pitara ṛṣayaḥ
verses.en: They call the, Cow immortal life, pay homage to the Cow as Death. She hath become this universe, Fathers, and Rishis, hath become the Gods, and men, and Asuras.

verses.sa:
य एवं विद्यात् स वशां प्रति गृह्णीयात्।
तथा हि यज्ञः सर्वपाद् दुहे दात्रेऽनपस्फुरन्॥
verses.tr: ya evaṃ vidyāt sa vaśāṃ prati gṛhṇīyāt tathā hi yajñaḥ sarvapād duhe dātre'napasphuran
verses.en: The man who hath this knowledge may receive the Cow with welcoming. i So for the giver willingly doth perfect. sacrifice pour milk,

verses.sa:
तिस्रो जिह्वा वरुणस्यान्तर्दीद्यत्यासनि ।
तासां या मध्ये राजति सा वशा दुष्प्रतिग्रहा॥
verses.tr: tisro jihvā varuṇasyāntardīdyatyāsani tāsāṃ yā madhye rājati sā vaśā duṣpratigrahā
verses.en: Within the mouth of Varuna three tongues are glittering with light: That which shines midmost of them is this Cow most difficult to hold,

verses.sa:
चतुर्धा रेतो अभवद् वशायाः ।
आपस्तुरीयममृतं तुरीयं यज्ञस्तुरीयं पशवस्तुरीयम्॥
verses.tr: caturdhā reto abhavad vaśāyāḥ āpasturīyamamṛtaṃ turīyaṃ yajñasturīyaṃ paśavasturīyam
verses.en: Four-parted was the Cow's prolific humour. One-fourth is Water, one-fourth life eternal, one-fourth is sacrifice, one-fourth are cattle,

verses.sa:
वशा द्यौर्वशा पृथिवी वशा विष्णुः प्रजापतिः ।
वशाया दुग्धमपिबन्त्साध्या वसवश्च ये॥
verses.tr: vaśā dyaurvaśā pṛthivī vaśā viṣṇuḥ prajāpatiḥ vaśāyā dugdhamapibantsādhyā vasavaśca ye
verses.en: The Cow is Heaven, the Cow is Earth, the Cow is Vishnu, Lord of Life, The Sadhyas and the Vasus have drunk the outpourings of the Cow,

verses.sa:
वशाया दुग्धं पीत्वा साध्या वसवश्च ये ।
ते वै ब्रध्नस्य विष्टपि पयो अस्या उपासते॥
verses.tr: vaśāyā dugdhaṃ pītvā sādhyā vasavaśca ye te vai bradhnasya viṣṭapi payo asyā upāsate
verses.en: When these, Sadhyas and Vasus, have drunk the out-pourings of the Cow, They in the Bright One's dwelling-place pay adoration to her milk.

verses.sa:
सोममेनामेके दुह्रे घृतमेक उपासते ।
य एवं विदुषे वशां ददुस्ते गतास्त्रिदिवं दिवः॥
ब्राह्मणेभ्यो वशां दत्त्वा सर्वांल्लोकान्त्समश्नुते ।
ऋतं ह्यऽस्यामार्पितमपि ब्रह्माथो तपः॥
verses.tr: somamenāmeke duhre ghṛtameka upāsate ya evaṃ viduṣe vaśāṃ daduste gatāstridivaṃ divaḥ brāhmaṇebhyo vaśāṃ dattvā sarvāṃllokāntsamaśnute ṛtaṃ hya'syāmārpitamapi brahmātho tapaḥ
verses.en: For Soma some have milked her: some worship the fatness she hath poured. "They who have given a cow to him who hath this knowledge have gone up to the third region of the sky. He who hath given a Cow unto the Brahmans winneth all the worlds, For Right is firmly set in her, devotion, and religious zeal,

verses.sa:
वशां देवा उप जीवन्ति वशां मनुष्याऽउत।
वशेदं सर्वमभवद् यावत् सूर्यो विपश्यति॥
verses.tr: vaśāṃ devā upa jīvanti vaśāṃ manuṣyā'uta vaśedaṃ sarvamabhavad yāvat sūryo vipaśyati
verses.en: Both Gods and mortal men depend for life and being on the Cow. She hath become this universe: all that the Sun surveys is she.
